author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description:**

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Global Payment Services (GPS), GPS INM Product team as Product Manager – Receivables.

**Job Introduction**

Manage the GPS INM receivables portfolio, encompassing UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect and structured B2B reconciliation products, including DART, ARR and third-party offerings. The role covers the end-to-end product lifecycle, from concept, development and enhancement to launch, maintenance and commercialisation. Working under the guidance of the Senior Product Manager, coordinate internal teams and external partners to deliver seamless client onboarding, effective collection and reconciliation solutions, robust supporting processes, sound product governance and a consistent client experience.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Manage the development, enhancement, launch, maintenance and ongoing performance of UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect, DART, ARR and other structured B2B and third-party reconciliation offerings.
* Translate client needs and business requirements into defined product designs, prioritised enhancements and actionable launch plans. Use market insights, competitor benchmarking and client feedback from Sales, Coverage and GPS teams to develop differentiated propositions, maintain a prioritised backlog and incorporate client validation and pilot feedback.
* Evaluate partnerships with acquiring providers, payment platforms and reconciliation solution providers. Coordinate IT, Operations, Client Management, GPS teams and external partners to deliver integrated client collection and reconciliation propositions, with clear ownership, agreed actions and appropriate partner due diligence and governance.
* Define and maintain end-to-end operating and service models covering client onboarding, production service continuity, collections, reconciliation, exception handling and ongoing servicing. Work with Operations and Client Management to document and agree workflows and resolve exceptions within agreed service timelines.
* Coordinate product deployments, enhancements, testing and launch readiness, with documented requirements and stakeholder approvals. Deliver assigned initiatives against agreed milestones and provide concise updates on priorities, progress, risks and decisions, escalating delivery dependencies promptly to the Senior Product Manager.
* Support commercialisation and client adoption through product collateral, sales enablement and ongoing enhancements. Partner with GPS and Coverage teams to convert client opportunities into suitable receivables solutions, tracking progress against agreed plans, product adoption and client usage.
* Ensure alignment with applicable regulatory guidelines and HSBC policies, internal controls and the Group Compliance Policy. Identify product, third-party and operational risks with risk stewards, coordinate controls and approvals, track mitigating actions and report losses appropriately. Support third-party assessments, regulatory reporting and client-issue resolution; monitor relevant collection, reconciliation and applicable partner chargeback/refund metrics; submit credit-risk exceptions and pricing decisions for approval; and ensure timely implementation of audit actions and resolution of regulator-raised issues.

**Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience:**

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, or equivalent, with a university degree and/or relevant training qualifications.
* Demonstrated progressive experience and a proven track record in cash management, receivables and/or payments product development and management, or equivalent relevant experience, including product development, project management, fintech engagement and market- or client-facing banking functions.
* Corporate transaction banking or cash management experience is preferred, but not mandatory. Experience in merchant acquiring, UPI collections, NACH, Virtual Accounts or structured B2B reconciliation is preferred, but not mandatory; familiarity with DART, ARR or third-party reconciliation offerings is beneficial.
* Demonstrated project and programme management experience, including co-creating solutions with IT and internal business partners. Excellent planning, organisation and time-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and deliver within tight deadlines.
* Ability to develop innovative, flexible solutions addressing client needs and to understand clients’ business models, operating needs and core business fundamentals. Sound business acumen and commercial awareness, including relevant economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory considerations.
* Strong interpersonal, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective internal and external relationships. A collaborative approach to teamwork, supported by self-motivation and a proactive working style.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to develop well-founded recommendations for decision-making. Familiarity with emerging technologies is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including clear, compelling presentations. Fluency in English is expected; additional language skills are beneficial.

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.**

**Additional Notes:**

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to help shape and scale our EdTech platform for JEE, NEET, and board-exam aspirants. You will own one or more product areas — learning, assessments, content, or growth — and will drive the roadmap from discovery to launch across web, Android, and iOS. You will work closely with founders, engineering, design, content, and marketing teams to deliver products that measurably improve student outcomes and business metrics.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap for your product area and align it with business, content, and engineering

priorities.

* Talk to students, parents, teachers, and internal teams to deeply understand pain points and

learning behavior.

* Translate insights into clear PRDs, user stories, flows, and acceptance criteria.

* Partner with design on wireframes, prototypes, and user testing; partner with engineering on scope, trade-offs, and delivery.

* Define, instrument, and track success metrics — engagement, retention, conversion, learning outcomes, and revenue.

* Run A/B experiments on pricing, paywalls, onboarding, notifications, and content discovery — and make data-backed calls on what ships.

* Collaborate on our conversion funnel — from YouTube/Shorts traffic to free users to paid course subscribers.

* Own feature launches end-to-end — launch plans, GTM alignment, customer comms, and

post-launch monitoring.

* Prioritize ruthlessly using frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort) and communicate priorities clearly to stakeholders.

* Use product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA, or similar) and work with data/BI to build dashboards for your area.

* Keep a close eye on the competitive landscape (Physics Wallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, etc.) and translate learnings into opportunities.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience in a consumer-facing product (preferably EdTech, mobile, or content platforms).

* Proven track record of shipping features that moved measurable business or user metrics.

* Strong user research skills — interviewing students/users, synthesizing insights, and turning

them into product decisions.

* Strong analytical skills and fluency with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA) and basic SQL for self-serve data pulls.

* Hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests and interpreting results with statistical rigor.

* Experience writing clear PRDs, success criteria, and release plans that engineering and design teams can execute on.

* Strong understanding of conversion funnels, retention, and monetization patterns — especially freemium / tiered pricing.

* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade-offs — APIs, microservices, mobile constraints, performance.

* Experience shipping on mobile-first products (Android and iOS) and understanding

platform-specific nuances.

* Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp one-pager, present to founders, and debate trade-offs clearly.

* Bias for action, high ownership, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in EdTech — particularly JEE/NEET/boards, K-12, or test-prep products.

* Experience building or scaling content-driven products (YouTube/Shorts funnels, creator-led GTM, live classes).

* Experience with assessments and test platforms — question banks, live tests, analytics on

student performance.

* Familiarity with growth loops, referrals, student ambassador programs, and community-led

growth.

* Exposure to live streaming products, push notification strategy, or

personalization/recommendations.

* Prior startup experience — 0®1 product building and operating in early/growth-stage

environments.

* MBA or equivalent structured business education (not required if experience is strong).

**What We're Looking For**

* Student-obsessed — you genuinely care about learning outcomes, not just feature velocity.

* First-principles thinker who can simplify complex problems and drive clarity for the team.

* Comfortable going from strategy to pixel-level detail in the same week.

* Data-driven, but not data-blind — you balance metrics with intuition and user empathy.

* Collaborative leader who earns trust across engineering, design, content, and marketing.

* High-agency — you spot problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
This is a growth-stage product operator role, not a 0-to-1 role. Webnyay has a mature product, established enterprise customers, live deployments, and meaningful transaction volumes across dispute resolution and grievance redressal.

Our platform powers complex workflows across arbitration, mediation, online dispute resolution, and BFSI grievance management. The product is live, the customers are real, and the operational challenges are substantial.

Your job is to grow it — through better, faster, and more scalable versions of what works, while building new capabilities that expand what our customers can do with Webnyay.

You should be comfortable working with complex workflows, demanding enterprise customers, and engineering teams. You should be equally comfortable understanding a legal or operational problem, translating it into a product requirement, and driving it all the way to deployment.

You'll Own

* **Product roadmap:** Owning and driving the roadmap across Webnyay's ODR, arbitration, mediation, BFSI dispute resolution, and grievance redressal products.
* **New feature development:** Identifying high-leverage opportunities from customer feedback, operational bottlenecks, and market requirements. Scoping and shipping capabilities that improve product value and expand our addressable market.
* **Backlog prioritisation:** Turning hundreds of customer requests, change requests, bug reports, and internal ideas into a coherent, prioritised shipping plan. Knowing what to build, what to defer, and what to push back on.
* **Enterprise workflow optimisation:** Understanding end-to-end dispute resolution workflows — from case initiation, notice generation and service, document management, hearings and arbitrator workflows to award generation, closure, billing, and reporting — and continuously improving them.
* **Customer-facing product management:** Working directly with customers, understanding their requirements, managing expectations, communicating feature releases, and handling difficult conversations around timelines, scope, and prioritisation.
* **Product documentation:** Writing clear PRDs, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and release notes that engineering and implementation teams can execute against.
* **Cross-functional execution:** Working closely with engineering leads, design, legal operations, implementation, business development, and customer success to take features from requirement to production.
* **Product analytics:** Using product usage, operational metrics, customer feedback, and workflow data to identify friction, measure adoption, and make informed product decisions.
* **Competitive positioning:** Tracking the legal-tech, ODR, BFSI technology, and enterprise SaaS landscape to identify product gaps, emerging capabilities, and opportunities to differentiate Webnyay.

You'll work directly with the leadership team and have significant ownership over product decisions and execution.

How We Work: AI-Native by Default

This is important enough to call out clearly: **we expect our Product Managers to use AI across the entire product lifecycle.** AI is not a separate workstream or an occasional productivity tool. It should be embedded in how you research, think, design, document, build, and ship.

That Means

* **Discovery:** Synthesising customer interviews, analysing support tickets and change requests at scale, researching legal and regulatory requirements, and gathering competitive intelligence using AI tools.
* **Definition:** Drafting PRDs, generating user stories, mapping workflows, identifying dependencies, and stress-testing edge cases before handing requirements to engineering.
* **Design:** Creating wireframes, prototyping interfaces, exploring UI variants, and validating user flows using tools such as Figma AI, v0, Lovable, or Claude.
* **Build:** Translating requirements into technical specifications, understanding APIs and system architecture, debugging alongside engineers, and using AI to review code and understand implementation trade-offs.
* **Launch:** Generating release notes, preparing customer communications, creating product documentation, and enabling sales and implementation teams with feature updates.
* **Measure:** Querying product data, analysing adoption and turnaround times, identifying workflow bottlenecks, generating hypotheses, and using AI to accelerate product analysis.
* **Automate:** Identifying repetitive workflows across product, operations, and customer delivery that can be simplified or automated using AI agents and integrations.

We don't expect you to be an engineer. We do expect you to be technically curious, resourceful, and capable of using modern AI tools to move faster and produce better work.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, fintech, legal-tech, or workflow automation.
* Experience owning an existing product and driving its roadmap, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong ability to translate ambiguous business and customer requirements into structured product specifications.
* Experience working with engineering teams and understanding technical trade-offs, APIs, integrations, and software architecture.
* Excellent written communication. You should be able to write a clear PRD, explain a complex workflow, and communicate a product decision without ambiguity.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data to prioritise opportunities and evaluate outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and demanding enterprise customers without losing sight of the product roadmap.
* A bias towards execution. You should be someone who takes ownership, follows through, and gets things shipped.
* Genuine interest in AI tools and a willingness to experiment with them as part of your everyday workflow.

**An added advantage:** Experience with legal workflows, arbitration, mediation, BFSI, lending, collections, grievance redressal, regulatory technology, or high-volume transaction platforms.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager-Senior Product Specialist
job_description:
**Product Management**

**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**

**About the Role**

Deloitte is looking for a hands-on product manager to own a product end-to-end within Deloitte Consulting Products. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the day-to-day of a product built for the US market—running discovery, shaping the roadmap, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to ship value clients actually use.

This is a builder's role at its core. You're the strongest product craftsperson on your product: closest to the user, closest to the backlog, and accountable for the outcomes it delivers. You'll work with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders to stay grounded in the market you're building for.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for your product, turning priorities into a clear plan of what to build next

* Make the day-to-day prioritization and trade-off calls, sequencing work by value, effort, and readiness

* Define and track the metrics that show it's working: adoption, engagement, retention, impact

* Know when something isn't working—flag it early and make the case to change course or stop

**Discover & Validate**

* Run discovery to understand your users and the problems worth solving, partnering with US product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders

* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and rapid validation before building at scale

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**[ WHO WE ARE]**

Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. Founded in 2007, KRAFTON consists of PUBG STUDIOS, Bluehole Studio, RisingWings, Striking Distance Studios, Dreamotion, Unknown Worlds, 5minlab, Neon Giant, KRAFTON Montréal Studio and ReLU Games, each trying to innovate the enjoyment of games through continuously embracing challenges and new technologies, expanding our platforms and services to win the hearts of more fans.

KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community.

The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties that include highly popular titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby, New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country.

With a focus on India, KRAFTON is dedicated to nurturing the gaming and start-up ecosystem. In line with this commitment, KRAFTON initiated the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) in October 2023. KIGI aims to support 6-10 teams annually with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally, KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years and has committed an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years.

**Responsibilities**

* Act as Product Manager, define and manage the **roadmap** for India-facing features, collaboration events, and engagement loops.
* Write clear **PRDs**, set success metrics, and make data-driven product decisions.
* Act as **feature producer**: plan sprints, track progress, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery.
* Lead **live-ops execution**, including events, content updates, reward systems, and real-time issue handling.
* Drive **user growth, onboarding, retention**, and monetization improvements for the Indian market.
* Collaborate with central teams, external partners, and marketing on feature launches and IP tie-ups.
* Analyze player data and market trends to optimize features and event performance.

**Qualification**

* 5 years in mobile gaming product management or production.
* Strong understanding of F2P systems, live-ops, and mobile game KPIs.
* Experience working cross-functionally with design, engineering, QA, and data.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.
* Available for International travel and work with cross-continent teams
* Passion for shooter games & Indian mobile gaming trends.

What you get in return

* Learn Best-in-class global product practices, and scope for fast growth
* Ability to learn from teams across the globe
* Open and transparent work culture with ownership
* Work on India’s biggest game of the decade.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Understands Analytics, Product Development, Producer Scrums very well, (AI part will be taught on the job)
* Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.
* Available for International travel and work with cross-continent teams
* Passion for shooter games & Indian mobile gaming trends.

title: Technical Product Manager - Lab Automation and Healthcare Solutions / Workflow Consultant
job_description:
**Job Requirements**  

To promote Lab Automation solutions and improve the productivity and efficiency of laboratory operations in the public and private sectors and facilitate transitional and change management processes for sites converting to a Siemens solution by creating lean laboratory automation designs, transition management processes and implementation expertise, ensuring customer satisfaction and quality throughout the design, implementation and optimization process.

**Product Management (Marketing) components of Role**

**Sales**  

* Support the sales team by becoming involved in the sales process (Blue Sheets, tenders, customer visits).
* Provide relevant scientific, technical information and performing Automation demonstrations / presentations where required.
* Participate in all aspects of new product launches.

**Marketing**  
Spend time in the field understanding market, developing key opinion leaders, coaching sales force in, and validating effectiveness of key messages

**Product Management**  
Assist in the Development and implementation of effective launch plans, key messages, promotional materials, advertising and sales support material for the specified product portfolio (including the effective management of product for promotion and case studies) and consistent with Global Marketing directions.

Stewardship of customer issues with the Global Siemens organization to drive resolution for or understanding of the technical needs of Indian market.

**HCS/ Workflow Components of Role**

As a HCS to effectively satisfy the customer's needs for the optimization of laboratory automation solutions and processes using Siemens proprietary optimization tools and external analytical programs. Ensure any identified defects are followed up internally with the service and applications support teams and lead the team in completing the optimization of the solution using lean methodologies. To occur 6 monthly at all automation sites (or more/less frequently as per customer contract requirements)

Provide laboratory consultative services to current and potential customers to aid in the design of complex laboratory automation solutions. Produce technical CAD drawings (focusing on automation design and services requirements - electrical, pneumatic, water, waste, etc) for complete laboratory solutions and work with project management for costings and implementation planning. Provide detailed transitional processes as part of the solution offering

Maintain personal knowledge of LEAN operational procedures and participate in training courses including classroom attendance, 'self learning', computer based and 'on the job' training.

title: Senior Product Manager - Fully Remote Job
job_description:
#### **About the company**

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.  
  
We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.  
  
A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.  
  
At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.  
  
Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?  
  
Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.  
  
**Our values**

* **Be a wolf, not a sheep:** we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
* **Knowledge equals power:** we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
* **Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy:** we want work to be something you look forward to.
* **Quality results in quantity:** we care about excellence and attention to detail.
* **TEAM, Together everyone achieves more:** collaboration is how we get our best results.

Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

#### **About the role**

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.
* Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.
* Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.
* Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.
* Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.
* Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

#### **What we are looking for**

**Competences**

* **Hosting & Security Products Knowledge:** Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.
* **Supplier & Vendor Management:** Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.
* **Commercial & P&L Acumen:** Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.
* **Product Strategy & Roadmapping:** Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.
* **Project & Programme Management:** Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
* **Data & Funnel Analytics:** Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
* **AI Proficiency:** Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

**How we work at Openprovider**

* **Self-management:** you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
* **Learning Agility and AI Literacy:** you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
* **Adaptive Innovation Mindset:** you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
* **Quality Orientation:** you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
* **Customer Focus:** you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

#### **What we offer**

* 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
* Paid time off and sick leave;
* International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
* Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
* Quarterly review and annual salary review;
* Flexible working hours;
* We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
* Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

#### **About us**

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

* **Project & Programme Management:** Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
* **Data & Funnel Analytics:** Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
* **AI Proficiency:** Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

**How we work at Openprovider**

* **Self-management:** you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
* **Learning Agility and AI Literacy:** you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
* **Adaptive Innovation Mindset:** you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
* **Quality Orientation:** you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
* **Customer Focus:** you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

#### **What we offer**

* 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
* Paid time off and sick leave;
* International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
* Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
* Quarterly review and annual salary review;
* Flexible working hours;
* We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
* Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

#### **About us**

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
The Opportunity

RoaDo helps shippers and logistics teams run domestic and cross-border freight on one connected platform. As a Product Manager, you'll take charge of one area of that platform. Depending on business needs at the time you join, it could be load planning, carrier sourcing and spot bidding, shipment visibility, our AI-driven control tower, digital proof of delivery, freight billing, or our export-import (EXIM) workflows. You'll partner with engineers, operations teams, and enterprise clients to turn real logistics problems into products that deliver clear business results.

Your Responsibilities

* Set the product direction and quarterly priorities for your area, and see them through to delivery

* Take full ownership of how users get work done in your module, from first sketch to everyday adoption

* Strengthen how RoaDo connects with the outside world: client ERPs, transporter systems, GPS and telematics devices, shipping lines, forwarders, customs brokers, and port terminals

* Give customers a single view of their international shipments, from factory gate to port, across the sea or air leg, and on to final delivery

* Spend regular time with exporters, importers, transporters, forwarders, and finance teams to find where work breaks down and decide what to fix first

* Write detailed requirement documents that leave little room for interpretation, and stay close to the engineering team through each sprint

* Choose the right success measures, such as usage, turnaround time, port dwell, and cost per shipment, and report on them consistently

What We're Looking For

* 3 to 5 years in product management, including at least 2 years running a B2B software product with full accountability

* Solid knowledge of road freight in India, both full-truckload and part-load, including how loads are planned, how transporters are selected, how trips are tracked, and how freight bills are settled

* Practical understanding of the truckload lifecycle: placing orders with transporters, monitoring trip milestones, handling waiting charges, and closing payments

* Good knowledge of export-import operations, including space booking, container handling at CFS and ICD, port movement, customs filing, and coordination with shipping lines and forwarders

* Comfort with core trade documents and terms such as Bill of Lading, Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, Incoterms, and demurrage and detention charges

* Experience with exception alerts, live visibility, or control-tower style products will set you apart

* Able to read API docs and work through integration details with engineers, including GPS and SIM-based tracking, container tracking feeds, webhooks, and ERP connections

* A data-driven mindset: you can estimate the size of a problem, pick the metric that matters, and build a persuasive case from numbers

* Strong written communication and the ability to align engineering and business teams around a spec

How You Use AI

We give real weight to this. RoaDo PMs are expected to use AI as part of their everyday toolkit.

* You regularly use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to analyse data and find patterns in product logs, customer tickets, and call notes

* You can quickly build a working prototype or demo to test an idea before engineering time is spent

* You use AI to speed up research, produce first drafts of specs, and challenge your own assumptions early

* You think about how AI can change what our product does for customers, such as reading trade documents automatically or predicting delays, and not only how it speeds up building

Bonus Points

* Background in multi-tenant enterprise SaaS

* Hands-on experience with freight forwarding, 3PL, or shipping line software, or with platforms like ICEGATE, PCS, or ULIP

* Exposure to multimodal freight across road, rail, sea, and air

* Working knowledge of Mixpanel, Metabase, Jira, or similar tools

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹749,301.00 - ₹1,100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Who Are We**
==============

Hansen Technologies is a global software and services provider supporting the energy, utilities, water, and telecommunications industries. Our solutions help organizations deliver essential services, introduce new products, engage customers, and manage critical revenue and customer operations across more than 80 countries.

As AI reshapes our industry, we are embedding intelligent capabilities across our products and operations to deliver smarter, faster, and more resilient solutions.

This is a full-time onsite role based in our Pune-Balewadi office.

  

**Why This Role Matters**
=========================

Our strategic AI agent platform and framework, enables secure, governed, and scalable AI capabilities across Hansen products.

We are looking for a Product Manager who can combine product strategy, delivery leadership, and people leadership. You will own the platform’s vision, roadmap, and end-to-end lifecycle, turning emerging AI innovation into a trusted enterprise platform with measurable adoption and customer value.

Working closely with our Chief Innovation Officer, AI Spark team, engineering, architecture, and global product stakeholders, you will bring structure, pace, and accountability to one of Hansen’s most important AI investments.

  

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, value proposition, and outcome-focused roadmap for Hansen Hansen’s AI platform.
* Own the full product lifecycle from discovery and prioritization through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Translate product goals into clear backlog priorities, release objectives, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans with Engineering and Architecture.
* Assess customer needs, market trends, AI capabilities, and internal product requirements to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Move innovation into production and BAU, keeping releases, bugs, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications on track.
* Lead and coach the cross-functional platform team while influencing senior stakeholders across a global, matrixed organization.

**What You Bring**
==================

* Strong product management experience in enterprise software, SaaS, platform products, or technology-led environments.
* Recent and credible exposure to AI/ML, Generative AI, agentic AI, AI platforms, or data-driven products. Coding experience is not required.
* Proven ownership of product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, lifecycle, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
* Delivery-management capability, including experience turning strategy into executable plans and maintaining momentum after launch.
* Experience moving an emerging product from innovation or build stage into secure, reliable, scalable production and BAU.
* People leadership, coaching, or mentoring experience, with confident executive-level communication and product advocacy.
* Ability to balance customer value, commercial priorities, technical complexity, governance, and delivery realities.

**Why Join Us?**
================

* Shape one of Hansen’s most strategic AI investments and influence how enterprise-grade AI agents are adopted across a global product portfolio.
* Own a high-visibility product roadmap and work directly with senior leaders, engineering teams, and product stakeholders.
* Turn fast-moving AI innovation into practical, secure, governed, and scalable platform capabilities.
* Join a collaborative, globally connected team that values ownership, openness, responsible innovation, and high-quality execution.
* Build your career with opportunities to influence Hansen’s wider product portfolio as Hansen’s AI platform scales.

**Contact Us**
==============

If you have the experience and enthusiasm to shape the future of Hansen Hansen’s AI platform, please “Apply Now” via the link or visit our careers page.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Visit our website at hansencx.com for more information.

  

**Data Privacy Notice**
=======================

By applying to this role, you consent to Hansen collecting, processing, and storing the information you provide for recruitment purposes. You also agree that your details may be securely retained in our talent database for future opportunities and reference in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

job_description:
Product Manager – ERP & Enterprise Applications  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)  
**Experience:** 5–8+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented **Product Manager** to lead the strategy, functional design, and development of our ERP and enterprise software products.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in ERP systems, product management, business process analysis, workflow design, and cross-functional team coordination. The role involves translating business requirements into scalable product features, managing product roadmaps, prioritizing development activities, and ensuring seamless integration across multiple ERP modules.

The candidate will work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Business Analysts, QA, Implementation, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of business-focused, scalable, and user-friendly enterprise solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Product Strategy & Roadmap Management

* Define and manage product vision, strategy, roadmap, and development priorities.
* Translate business objectives and customer requirements into scalable product features.
* Identify product gaps, improvement opportunities, and process inefficiencies.
* Prioritize product features and development backlogs based on business value, customer needs, and technical feasibility.
* Ensure consistency across different ERP modules and product functionalities.

2. ERP Functional Design & Business Process Management

* Understand and define business processes across ERP modules such as Finance, Accounting, Sales, Procurement, Inventory, HR, CRM, and Operations.
* Design end-to-end workflows, business rules, approval hierarchies, validations, and transaction lifecycles.
* Define relationships, dependencies, and data flows between different ERP modules.
* Identify functional gaps and recommend process improvements and automation opportunities.
* Ensure the ERP product supports multi-company, multi-branch, and role-based access requirements.

3. Requirements Gathering & Documentation

* Conduct client meetings, requirement-gathering sessions, and business discovery workshops.
* Translate business requirements into product requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain product documentation, including PRDs, functional specifications, process diagrams, and user guides.
* Ensure requirements are clearly documented and communicated to Engineering and QA teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability and manage scope changes throughout the product lifecycle.

4. Product Development & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Engineering teams to translate functional requirements into technical deliverables.
* Collaborate with UI/UX Designers to review wireframes, prototypes, user journeys, and product interfaces.
* Coordinate with Business Analysts, QA, and Documentation teams to ensure product quality and completeness.
* Review functional specifications and product designs before development handoff.
* Monitor product development progress, release schedules, and feature delivery.

5. API & System Integration

* Define functional requirements for REST APIs, third-party integrations, and data exchange.
* Understand JSON, webhooks, API operations, data mapping, and system dependencies.
* Coordinate with Engineering teams to validate integration requirements and error-handling scenarios.
* Ensure seamless communication and data consistency between ERP modules and external applications.

6. Product Customization & Decision-Making

* Evaluate customer requirements and determine whether they should be incorporated into the core product, offered as configurable features, handled through integrations, or developed as customizations.
* Assess business value, development effort, scalability, and long-term maintenance impact.
* Identify recurring client requirements that can be converted into reusable product features.
* Ensure customer-specific customizations do not affect overall product consistency and maintainability.
* Take ownership of functional decisions and resolve cross-functional issues.

7. Client & Stakeholder Management

* Act as a key point of contact for product-related discussions with clients.
* Conduct product demonstrations, requirement discussions, and functional walkthroughs.
* Manage client expectations regarding product functionality, scope, dependencies, and timelines.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Sales, Implementation, Support, and other internal stakeholders.
* Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities for continuous product improvement.

**Required Technical Skills**

* ERP and multi-module enterprise product management.
* Product roadmap planning and backlog prioritization.
* Business process mapping and workflow design.
* Functional specifications, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and system integrations.
* SQL fundamentals, database relationships, and data mapping.
* Requirements traceability and scope management.
* Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycle.
* Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent project management tools.
* Understanding of UI/UX design principles and wireframing tools such as Figma.

**Preferred / Advanced Skills**

* Experience in financial, banking, accounting, lending, or payment-related products.
* Knowledge of BPMN, UML, swimlane, sequence, and state-transition diagrams.
* Familiarity with Swagger/OpenAPI and Postman.
* Experience with approval engines and workflow automation.
* Knowledge of multi-tenant SaaS, multi-company, and multi-branch ERP structures.
* Understanding of audit trails, maker-checker controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with user research and usability testing.
* Knowledge of CMMI / ISO quality standards.

**Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies**

* Strong product ownership and decision-making abilities.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
* Effective client and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to coordinate and influence multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and take end-to-end ownership.

**Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
* 5–8+ years of relevant experience in Product Management, ERP Systems, Enterprise Software, Business Systems Analysis, or Product Development.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience owning a product, module, or significant product roadmap.
* Demonstrated experience in defining and delivering ERP, multi-module enterprise products, or SaaS business applications.
* Proven experience in client-facing requirement discovery and stakeholder management.
* Practical understanding of API integrations, data flows, and system dependencies.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO).
* SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager.
* CBAP / CCBA or equivalent Business Analysis certification.
* Relevant ERP or Product Management certifications.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a product-oriented professional who combines business understanding, functional expertise, and technical awareness to drive ERP product development. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing product priorities, understanding complex business workflows, coordinating cross-functional teams, and making informed product decisions to deliver scalable and business-focused enterprise solutions.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in ERP Product Management, ERP Functional Design, or Enterprise Software Development?
* Do you have hands-on experience in gathering business requirements and designing ERP workflows across modules such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Inventory, HR, or CRM?
* Do you have experience preparing product requirement documents (PRDs), functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria while coordinating with development and QA teams?
* Are you an immediate joiner?

Work Location: In person

title: Staff Product Manager, Time & Attendance
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

**Opportunity**

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* **Commercial Impact.** Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* **Operational Velocity.** Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* **Customer Empathy.** Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* **A Product Leader.** 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.
* **Strategic & Influential.** You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
* **Domain Depth.** You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
* **A Proven Growth Driver.** You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
* **An Ambitious Problem Solver.** You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
* **Customer Obsessed & Analytical.** You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
* **Technical Fluency.** You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
* **Education.** BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Senior Product Manager - Managed Detection Response(MDR)
job_description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Position Overview and Objective**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to oversee our network appliance and fleet management infrastructure.

The Senior Product Manager: Network Appliance will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the applications and capabilities we deploy and support on our network appliance platform as well as the infrastructure required to manage our fleet at scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for the applications and capabilities deployed and supported on the platform.

* Drive Datapath capabilities, including IDS, syslog ingestion & pre-parsing, network ML.

* Own on premises features that bridge Arctic Wolf’s cloud to the customer environment via the network appliance platform.

* Define and own licensing, entitlement & SKU structure for product and service sales and pricing.

* Own the customer portal and public APIs, including the customer user experience and interaction with our products and services through both the customer portal and public API usage.

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of software on the fleet – from imaging and configuration, to release management and device upgrades, to fleet-wide monitoring and operations.

* Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for appliance imaging & configuration, including build processes, manufacturer infrastructure deployment, fleet configuration & feature flag management, and zero-touch provisioning.

* Own release management & device upgrades, including fleet rollout practices, containerized application delivery systems (e.g., Docker, ECR) as a reusable platform capability, and the over-the-air (OTA) upgrade experience.

* Own the base OS lifecycle for our Linux RTK OS – major version migration planning, patch cadence, and LTS/EOL policy, and the upgrade infrastructure for the existing fleet.

* Drive fleet management capabilities: dashboards, telemetry aggregation and analysis, and fleet-level configuration and feature-flag operations. Building product features to ensure the scalability and maintainability of our fleet.

* Own vulnerability and CVE patch management, including the field escalation feedback loop from Support & Security teams and engineering.

* Partner with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, to translate strategic initiatives into executable engineering plans for a dedicated feature team.

* Partner with peer product managers to ensure network appliance platform capabilities support the deployment and monitoring of your roadmap initiatives.

* Collaborate with sales on new feature and configuration support.

* Author and maintain detailed functional and technical specifications in product briefs and requirement documents, and support backlog grooming and sprint planning.

Conduct competitive and technical research to inform roadmap decisions and differentiate our appliance services offering.  

  

**Experience & Requirements**

* 10+ years of prior product management experience, ideally in network security, cybersecurity, or appliance/edge software.

* Engineering or technical background, such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Software Engineering.

* Experience with network detection/datapath technologies, API design, or licensing/entitlement systems.

* Experience with Jira, agile planning tools, and product analytics platforms.
Good To Have: Experience with intrusion detection systems, network traffic analysis, or deception technology.  

  

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**
===================================================================================

job_description:
Position Type

Full Time

Career area

Program, Product & Project Management

Location

4/F, WeWork, Embassy GolfLinks, Karnataka, Karnātaka 560093, India

Job ID

R-97034

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

As Principal Product Manager in Nike's India Technology Center (ITC), you will own the long-term product direction of one of the foundational platforms behind Nike's merchandising. You will sit within Consumer Product & Innovation (CP&I), the technology engine behind Nike's product creation, merchandising, design, and innovation, and report to a Director of Product Management. You will partner closely with global Product, Engineering, Program Management, and Business stakeholders across Nike's matrixed environment. You will also work shoulder-to-shoulder with peers across CP&I and adjacent product organizations to align platform capabilities, evolve foundational tools, and shape the next generation of Nike's merchandising experience across Footwear, Apparel, and Accessories.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a seasoned product leader who leads through deep craft, technical fluency, and broad influence, not through direct authority. You bring a multi-year view of where platforms should go, with the discipline to deliver outcomes one quarter at a time. You are equally comfortable shaping the future architecture with engineering leaders, simplifying complex problems for executives, and partnering with global merchants to turn workflow needs into product.

You have led enterprise-scale platform and internal products before, where the technical and operational depth is real. **Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description:**

  

We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, governance and strategic direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

  

The People Technology Foundation Product Manager will provide accountable ownership for the People Foundation portfolio, ensuring that core workforce data, employee lifecycle capabilities, organisational structures and supporting technologies are governed, prioritised, optimised and developed in line with business priorities.

  

Reporting to the Group People Technology Manager, you will work closely with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead, Senior Product Specialists, Project Managers and colleagues across the wider function. You will work with People teams, business regions, IT, Finance, Enterprise Architecture, external partners and suppliers across a portfolio initially comprising SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and OpenText, with future scope expected to include capabilities such as Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation services.

  

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Foundation portfolio, ensuring it delivers measurable business value today while evolving to meet future organisational needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the People Technology Foundation product strategy, roadmap, backlog and priorities, ensuring investment and delivery remain aligned to business objectives and long-term technology direction.
* Act as the accountable owner for the Foundation portfolio, including SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and OpenText, with future scope expected to include Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation capabilities.
* Balance immediate operational priorities with quarterly objectives, 12-18 month roadmap commitments and longer-term capability evolution, ensuring the portfolio delivers measurable value today while supporting future organisational needs.
* Lead and develop the Foundation product team, providing direction, coaching, prioritisation and performance management while building product, platform and delivery capability across the Foundation domain.
* Partner with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead and participate in intake, demand and prioritisation processes, assessing Foundation-related incidents, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and project requests.
* Own delivery outcomes across the Foundation portfolio, determining the most appropriate delivery approach through internal capability, blended delivery teams and partner-led delivery models.
* Define expected benefits, success measures and business outcomes, monitoring value realisation to ensure technology investment delivers measurable benefit.
* Own the Foundation product data model, configuration, business rules and information structures, ensuring workforce data structures support business processes, reporting, compliance, workforce planning and future capability requirements.
* Build strong relationships with regional and global stakeholders, balancing local requirements with global standards, strategic priorities and product direction.
* Lead and develop the Foundation People Technology Community, creating structured engagement, feedback, knowledge-sharing and adoption mechanisms across regions and stakeholder groups.
* Drive adoption of leading practices across the Foundation portfolio, continuously assessing technology developments, market trends and industry approaches to improve product performance, user experience and business value.
* Monitor product health, service performance, adoption, usability and operational effectiveness, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and optimisation.
* Remain accountable for the quality, completeness and maintenance of Foundation product documentation, ensuring governance, audit, support and operational requirements are met.
* Own product relationships with support and delivery partners, reviewing commitments and outcomes, challenging recommendations where appropriate and driving effective knowledge transfer to build internal capability.
* Partner with architecture, security, data and integration teams to ensure solutions remain sustainable, compliant and aligned to enterprise standards and future technology direction.
  

**Candidate Specification:**

  

**Essential**

  

* Significant experience managing enterprise technology products, platforms or services within a complex organisation.
* Significant hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, including product ownership, roadmap planning, capability development and stakeholder management.
* Experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, backlogs and priorities for enterprise technology products.
* Experience leading and developing product, platform, systems or technology teams, with responsibility for performance, coaching, prioritisation and capability development.
* Experience translating business requirements, operational challenges and strategic objectives into product outcomes and measurable value.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes, organisational structures, employee lifecycle processes and Foundation capabilities.
* Experience managing product demand, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and investment decisions within a structured governance framework.
* Experience working with business stakeholders, regional teams, technology teams and third-party suppliers to deliver business outcomes.
* Experience managing partner-delivered services and balancing delivery through internal teams, blended teams and external providers.
* Strong stakeholder leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively, build consensus and operate effectively at senior leadership level.
* Experience operating within a product-led delivery model and establishing governance, product processes and ways of working within new, evolving or transforming technology environments.
* Ability to balance immediate operational priorities with medium and long-term product strategy and roadmap planning.
* Experience using product performance, service performance, stakeholder feedback and business outcomes to drive continuous improvement and investment decisions.
  

**Desirable:**

  

* Additional SAP SuccessFactors certifications.
* Experience within People Technology, HR Technology or enterprise business application portfolios.
* Experience supporting OpenText or enterprise document and records management solutions.
* Experience supporting Time Off, Absence Management or Workforce Administration capabilities.
* Experience supporting Payroll technologies, payroll integrations or payroll-related HR processes.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, operating model change or organisational mobilisation initiatives.
* Experience developing and leading communities of practice, user groups, super-user networks or People Technology Communities.
* Experience with application portfolio management tools such as LeanIX.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, technology lifecycle management or service governance.
* Experience working within a global, complex or matrixed organisation.
  

**Qualifications & Certifications - Desirable**

**Product**

  

* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Certification
* Additional SAP SuccessFactors certifications, particularly Employee Central Payroll, Time Management, Platform Foundations or Position Management.
  

**Product & Delivery**

* SAFe Product Manager / Product Owner
* AgilePM
* Scrum Product Owner
* Scrum Master

**Service Management**

ITIL Foundation or higher certification

  

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.
