Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

* Prioritize and re-evaluate requirements throughout the product lifecycle
* Understand the product strategy, roadmap, and future releases
* Break work into user stories and manageable tasks aligned to OKRs
* Create user flows, acceptance criteria, and definitions of done
* Drive backlog grooming and prioritization activities
* Understand team capacity, priorities, and impediments
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and provide constructive feedback
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to understand and analyze process flow diagrams
* Solid listening, communication, and collaboration skills
* Product-focused mindset

* Experience with product management tools such as Aha!, Rally, and GitHub
* Understanding of personas and customer journeys
* Knowledge of healthcare industry processes and technology

title: Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners (FDDPs) – Healthcare Domain - Product Manager II
job_description:
**Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners (FDDPs) – Healthcare Domain**

**Converge for Healthcare | Deloitte Consulting**

**About the Role**

**The Team**

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, part of Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering- and innovation-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions.

Data Studio is Converge for Healthcare's foundational platform—combining agentic AI and analytics capabilities atop a unified healthcare data foundation to turn healthcare data into decision-ready insight and automated action across the Converge for Healthcare product portfolio.

Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners are the business and domain half of Converge for Healthcare's Forward Deployed model. Where Product Forward Deployed Engineers (pFDEs) cover product and technology, FDDPs cover business and domain—partnering with pFDEs, client account teams, and product teams to define the real client problem, prove measurable value, and identify where the platform can deliver more, feeding real-world domain learnings back into the platform roadmap.

**Position Summary**

As a Forward Deployed Domain Practitioner within Converge for Healthcare, you will work directly with clients, Deloitte Consulting's broader Health Care consulting practice, and Converge Health's product and engineering teams. Paired with a pFDE on each engagement, you'll bring the client-domain fluency that shapes what gets built on Data Studio and why—defining the business problem and success criteria, aligning client stakeholders on what value means, and translating real operational workflows into the requirements, rules, and edge cases the pFDE builds against.

This is a domain-led, business-facing role grounded in production reality rather than abstract requirements. You'll work alongside real users, real workflows, and real data, on engagements that are scoped, time-boxed, and exit-oriented—leaving behind documented domain artifacts and reusable patterns so that each deployment makes the next one materially faster.

The role draws on healthcare breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning provider and payer domains—from revenue cycle, utilization management, and clinical operations to network strategy, risk adjustment, actuarial, and beyond.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Work You'll Do**

* **Presales & opportunity shaping:** Partner with Health Care consulting teams, account teams, and pFDEs during the sales cycle—leading business discovery, mapping current-state workflows, and building the value hypothesis and business case, while the pFDE leads technical discovery and demonstrations, to qualify client needs into Product fit or out to Services as custom scope.

* **Business problem definition & success criteria:** Frame each use case around a concrete operational problem, establish baseline performance, and define measurable outcomes the client and Deloitte agree on (e.g., denial rates, days in A/R, prior authorization turnaround, coding accuracy, care-gap closure).

* **Domain-to-build translation:** Translate business needs into the workflow logic, decision rules, policy references, exceptions, and acceptance criteria the pFDE builds against—and contribute domain-accurate, labelled test cases to the use case's evaluation set so agent outputs are judged against how the work is actually done.

job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Job Introduction**

Tekion is expanding its platform into security and compliance products for automotive retail, and we are hiring a senior product professional to own this new product area end to end. This role will build across two connected domains:

* **Compliance / GRC:** Products that help dealerships meet regulatory obligations, including F&I deal compliance, privacy and data governance, and evolving federal and state requirements, directly within the systems they already use.

* **Cybersecurity:** A modular suite of security capabilities delivered as independent products over time, including vulnerability and network scanning, continuous exposure management, endpoint detection and response, email security, credential-exposure monitoring, data-loss prevention, and log analytics / SIEM.

This is both a zero-to-one and scaling mandate. The role will define strategy, roadmap, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market approach, turning validated customer demand into shippable, monetizable products. The role requires close collaboration with US-based stakeholders and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

What You’ll Own

* Product strategy for Tekion’s security and compliance product lines, including the vision, boundaries, and how the two domains reinforce one another.

* Roadmaps for both domains, including sequencing of a modular, SKU-based product portfolio and defining the scope of each release.

* Packaging and pricing models, including subscriptions, consumption-based models, entitlements, and bundling.

* Voice of customer through continuous discovery with dealerships and dealer groups to validate demand before build.

* Cross-functional delivery in partnership with engineering, design, GTM, legal/compliance, security, and platform teams.

Key Responsibilities

Product Development & Strategy

* Own the holistic vision, roadmap, strategy, and launch plan for Automotive Security Cloud across security and compliance workstreams.

* Conduct market and competitive research to identify customer needs, product opportunities, market size, and differentiation.

* Define product positioning, messaging, and business rationale for new security and compliance offerings.

* Build alignment across product, engineering, security, compliance, GTM, legal, and leadership stakeholders.

Requirements & Analysis

* Run continuous customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized, well-specified product requirements.

* Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch requirements; partner with engineering on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.

* Track relevant regulatory requirements, including GLBA Safeguards, FTC rules, CCPA/CPRA, and GDPR, and translate obligations into product capabilities.

* Assess feasibility, risks, dependencies, costs, infrastructure needs, and resource requirements for proposed capabilities.

Go-to-Market & Commercialization

* Define the product/SKU catalog, entitlements, packaging, and pricing models for individual offerings and bundles.

* Build business cases and revenue models for new products, including subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU approaches.

* Recruit and manage design partners, run pilots, and convert validated pilots into referenceable customers and GA launches.

* Represent the product area to executives, sales, customers, and partners; support enablement, launch planning, and market entry.

* Define success metrics such as adoption, attach rate, retention, revenue, and risk reduction, and ensure products are instrumented to measure outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Lead collaboration across technical teams working on areas such as email security, vulnerability management, continuous testing, detection, compliance, and platform integration.

* Maintain alignment with leadership stakeholders on product progress, roadmap decisions, customer feedback, and market dynamics.

* Make independent product decisions with strong ownership, accountability, and clear communication.

* Set and communicate a multi-quarter vision and roadmap with measurable outcomes.

Must-Have Qualifications

* 7+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning security, compliance/GRC, infrastructure, platform, or B2B SaaS products.

* Strong product management fundamentals, including discovery, roadmap definition, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and translating business goals into executable requirements.

* Domain knowledge in at least one of the following: US automotive retail, dealership operations, F&I, DMS/CRM ecosystems, cybersecurity, GRC/privacy tooling, SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability/exposure management, or DLP.

* Demonstrated experience taking a zero-to-one product to market or scaling an existing product line.

* Working knowledge of security architectures, threat models, security controls, and relevant compliance frameworks.

* Experience with subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU packaging and pricing for B2B SaaS products.

* Proven ability to work autonomously, make decisions independently, and drive products from concept through launch.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into clear product decisions.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.

* Comfortable working with US-based teams and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

Good-to-Have Qualifications

* Experience selling into or building products for regulated SMB or mid-market verticals.

* Familiarity with building on a platform or system of record such as DMS, CRM, or ERP.

* Experience productizing an internal capability into a customer-facing offering.

* Familiarity with ISO standards, SOC 2, dealership compliance, privacy regulations, and broader security governance needs.

* Hands-on exposure to security product categories such as vulnerability scanners, continuous penetration testing platforms, email security, threat detection, endpoint security, cloud security, or SIEM/log analytics.

* Experience evaluating build, buy, or partner decisions based on technical feasibility, cost, time-to-market, integration effort, vendor maturity, and long-term differentiation.

* Track record launching greenfield products, entering new markets, or operating in early-stage or 0-to-1 environments.

* Experience with pricing strategy, cost analysis, revenue modeling, or budget planning for security or compliance products.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

job_description:
For Singapore Applicants:  
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* Experience with mobile app security, app store ecosystems, or content moderation platforms.
* Technical familiarity with LLM security evaluation, AI threat models (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), or static/dynamic code analysis tools.
* Strong data-driven mindset with experience defining and optimizing multi-objective platform metrics (safety vs. speed vs. operational cost).

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The App and Ecosystem Trust (AET) team ensures safe, secure, and trustworthy experiences across our global app ecosystem. job_description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  

**Principal Product Manager IT/OT D-Hub**

**POSITION PURPOSE:**

The Principal Product Manager is responsible for the overall product vision, strategy and roadmap across a specific Platform or domain and works on the hardest problems within the Platform. They make specific contributions to Product and Platform delivery by working directly with Product Squads within the Platform to ensure each product is oriented toward business outcomes that improve company performance. The Principal Product Manager partners directly with the Platform Lead and their teams to deliver. The Principal Product Manager is an expert communicator that represents the Platform by presenting to senior leaders across Bayer and externally to accelerate digital transformation and build Bayer’s reputation as a digital leading company.

Principal Product Managers apply the product management discipline to some of the hardest problems within the Platform. They ensure that products are fulfilling their primary purpose to enable users to perform tasks that create value for the company by:

* Setting strategic vision for the product to ensure the customer and their needs are at the center; and ensuring team priorities are supporting business outcomes for customer, product, technical and enabling teams. This requires continual alignment of the product strategy and objectives with customer, product, technical, and enabling teams

* Managing the product backlog, which prioritizes the work of the assigned squads, to achieve the vision and aligned strategy.

To successfully manage these areas of responsibility, Principal Product Managers must have a deep understanding of the product domain, related technology, and architecture.

  

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Product Management**

The product manager is accountable for the overall success of a product throughout its lifecycle, from conception to decommissioning. They identify domain needs, develop, and validate product concepts, and build a business case. They oversee the product's build and launch, including any sourced services; as well as ensure product availability, stability, and compliance needs are met. Product managers collaborate with various teams, including product development, marketing, finance, legal, manufacturing, operations, and sales, as needed, to ensure cohesive progress and success.

Product Managers drive agile best practices with the team to improve delivery, including continuous planning ahead of each development cycle (e.g. sprint planning) and working together to co-create user stories aligned with the product backlog prioritization. In addition to guiding the team product managers have duties like market opportunity identification, competitive analysis, sales enablement, or monitoring domain performance.

* **Stakeholder Engagement**

It is vital for the product manager to identify their key stakeholder group. Though many strong and loud opinions will be expressed, an effective product manager uses discretion to deliver their product in a way that meets the needs of users and stakeholders who will ensure value is realized for Bayer. Stakeholders should trust that the product manager not only understands their needs but will actively work to ensure their needs are met while delivering the product.

* **Product Strategy**

The product manager must provide strategic leadership with full end-to-end ownership for their assigned products throughout the entire product lifecycle. They are responsible for planning and optimizing capabilities to deliver business outcomes in the most efficient way. Product managers require strong strategic planning, decision making, and influencing skills to balance the needs of users and various stakeholders.

* **Product Discovery & Delivery**

The product manager is responsible for creating comprehensive product roadmaps, to clarify user needs and non-functional requirements. They provide product oversight by tracking and reporting progress against 90-day outcomes and overall product health (including budget responsibilities). They also plan and manage product delivery while streamlining the corresponding backlog. Product managers are responsible for monitoring user feedback and metrics to co-create solutions that drive a better user experience and deliver more business value. They leverage Design Thinking methodology starting with user needs to prioritize problems and through discovery they perform usability, feasibility, business fit and value testing to determine the optimal solution.

* **People & Collaboration**

Product managers must proactively communicate and collaborate with product users and stakeholders, which requires strong strategic communication skills. Effective cross-functional collaboration is critical for product managers, bringing together diverse skills and knowledge to deliver a valuable product. It's important to maintain strong and productive working relationships with colleagues in product management, engineering, and other technically focused organizations. The Principal Product Manager serves as a Product Management Chapter Lead for their Platform, where they are responsible for development of the product management community to improve product management and agile practices, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  

**WHO YOU ARE:**

**Required -**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or similar or minimum 4 years equivalent practical experience in addition to:
* 10 or more years of experience as a product manager
* 5 or more years of experience with Agile development and DevOps

**Preferred –**

* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence initiatives that involve cross-functional teams from initiation to delivery
* Demonstrated experience with Design Thinking, user-centered design & user analysis
* Ability to establish and manage initiatives against a set of key metrics and goals
* Expert analytical, management and organizational skills
* Expert verbal and written communication abilities: must effectively communicate with technical and non-technical people
* Expert Experience in building product vision, product roadmap, product strategy, and competitive analysis
* Proven experience in designing, developing, delivering or leading digital solutions in a large-scale, highly complex global environment
* Strong strategic planning and decision-making skills with ability to evolve solution strategy based on research, data and industry trends
* Ability to measure and effectively communicate the business value of proposals and deliverables

  

**Ever feel burnt out by bureaucracy? Us too. That's why we're changing the way we work- for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Learn more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here**

**https://www.bayer.com/enfstrategyfstrategy**

**Please don’t rely upon any unsolicited email from email addresses not ending with domain name “bayer.com” or job advertisements referring you to an email address that does not end with “bayer.com”. For checking the authenticity of such emails or advertisement you may approach us at HROP\_INDIA@BAYER.COM.**

**YOUR APPLICATION**

  
  

Bayer is an equal opportunity employer that strongly values fairness and respect at work. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, religion, gender, age, physical characteristics, disability, sexual orientation etc. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.

**Location:**

India : Karnataka : Bangalore

  

**Division:**

Enabling Functions

  

**Reference Code:**

896367

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (AI Agents) - Bengaluru
job_description:
We are looking for a technically strong Product Manager with hands-on experience building AI-powered products and agents. You will own product strategy, customer discovery and roadmap for enterprise AI applications, turning complex workflows into scalable, reusable product capabilities.

**Company Details**

Live2.ai is building an AI-native Social Content Intelligence Operating System for global consumer brands.

Its platform uses AI agents to monitor conversations, audit campaigns, analyse consumer behaviour, track influencers and turn social content into commerce. The product combines LLM orchestration, reasoning agents, multimodal AI and enterprise workflow automation.

Website: https://live2.ai/

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise platforms or AI products.
* Mandatory hands-on product management experience with AI/LLM-powered applications or AI agents.
* Practical understanding of LLMs, prompting, RAG, tool calling, agent workflows and AI evaluation.
* Strong technical understanding of APIs, integrations, distributed systems and data architecture.
* Experience translating complex customer problems into product requirements and shipping products with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to distinguish reusable product capabilities from customer-specific customisations.
* Comfortable working directly with enterprise customers and technical teams.
* Willingness to work from the Bengaluru office.

**Responsibilities**

* Own product vision, strategy, roadmap and prioritisation for enterprise AI products and agent platforms.
* Drive customer discovery across enterprise customers and identify recurring workflow problems.
* Convert customer requirements into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
* Define product experiences for building, configuring, testing, evaluating and improving AI agents.
* Work with AI and Engineering teams on tool calling, retrieval, model selection, guardrails and failure handling.
* Define success metrics for AI agents, including task completion, accuracy, reliability, latency and cost.
* Drive enterprise integrations, APIs, permissions, governance and platform readiness.
* Create PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Use prototypes and lightweight proofs of concept to validate product assumptions.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, AI, Sales, Solutions and Customer Success teams.
* Track product adoption, customer value, retention and platform scalability.

**Job Details**

Bengaluru, Work from Office

**Interview Process**

* Introductory Discussion
* Product & Technical Deep Dive
* Practical Product Exercise
* Founder Discussion

**Important Note**

ClanX is a recruitment partner, helping Live2.ai hire a Product Manager for its Enterprise AI Agents team.

title: Product Manager, Advanced
job_description:
**Overview:**

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

**What We're Looking For:**

The Product Manager, Advanced plays a pivotal role in shaping the company's product offerings, ensuring products meet market demands, and enhancing customer satisfaction. This role focuses on developing expertise in product lifecycle management, competitive market analysis, and cross-functional collaboration while contributing to innovation and business growth. This is an opportunity to influence product vision, solve complex problems, and create value for customers worldwide.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  
• Develop a deep understanding of Zebra's products, competitive landscape, distribution channels, and customer needs
  
• Advocate for the voice of the customer, integrating their feedback into product development processes
  
• Act as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication and alignment
  
• Define and execute demand generation initiatives in an effort to drive realization of product revenue plans in collaboration with regional product and marketing
  
• Owns product lifecycle management for assigned product lines including tactical execution, managing customer requirements, developing and driving end of life plans and execution of inventory objectives

• Define and manage product offerings following the New Product Introduction (NPI) process
  
• Drive innovation by identifying and leveraging emerging technologies to create competitive differentiation
  
• Mentor and guide junior team members, sharing best practices and industry knowledge
  
• Provides recommendations to influence distribution strategy to meet market needs
  
• Supports product launch by providing a comprehensive understanding of the value proposition
  
• Deliver product training to sales, sales engineers, technical support and other internal and external stakeholders
  
• Works closely with development teams and other key stakeholders to oversee new product development to validate development is on spec. Identifies beta site targets and drafts and implements plans

**Key Skills and Competencies:**

* Experience with AI-driven tools, such as machine learning-based diagnostic systems, virtual assistants, or predictive maintenance solutions to improve customer support operations
* Strong problem solving skills and the ability to make data driven decisions
* Advanced proficiency in tools such as Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, JIRA, and Confluence
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as Scrum and SAFe frameworks
* Knowledge and understanding of SW applications relevant to the use of the products for the markets and use cases enabled by the products
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to convey complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong business acumen and customer orientation with a proven ability to balance customer needs with business goals
* Advanced knowledge of market dynamics and competitive landscapes in relevant categories

  
**Minimum Education or Equivalent:**  

* Bachelors Degree in related discipline. Advanced Degree also acceptable. Candidates with 6+ years of experience will be considered if they hold a Masters Degree. In lieu of a degree, candidates with 12+ years of extensive and relevant product management experience and technical expertise will be considered if they have advanced knowledge of market dynamics, a track record of mentoring junior team members, and strong leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills to bridge technical and business stakeholders. Must be able to demonstrate evidence of an entrepreneurial mindset

**Minimum Work Experience:**

* 8+ years of experience

**Work Environment:** Hybrid

**Safety Sensitive Role:** No

**Travel:** Up to 25%

**Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):** No

**Must be able to see color:** No

**Physical Demands:**  

* Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting or standing

**Benefits:**

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

**Job Posting Statement:**

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

**AI Technology Statement:**

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy .

In lieu of a degree, candidates with 12+ years of extensive and relevant product management experience and technical expertise will be considered if they have advanced knowledge of market dynamics, a track record of mentoring junior team members, and strong leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills to bridge technical and business stakeholders. Must be able to demonstrate evidence of an entrepreneurial mindset

**Minimum Work Experience:**

* 8+ years of experience

**Work Environment:** Hybrid

**Safety Sensitive Role:** No

**Travel:** Up to 25%

**Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):** No

**Must be able to see color:** No

**Physical Demands:**  

* Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting or standing

**Benefits:**

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

**Job Posting Statement:**

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

**AI Technology Statement:**

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy .

title: Product Manager
job_description:
Company: Curavea Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

Department: Product Management

Designation: Product Manager

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager for our pharmaceutical business. The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing product strategies, managing product portfolios, supporting sales and marketing activities, and driving brand growth in the market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & Brand Management

* Manage the company's pharmaceutical product portfolio.
* Develop brand strategies to increase product sales and market share.
* Plan and execute new product launches.
* Identify opportunities for existing product growth.

2. Market Research & Analysis

* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Monitor competitor brands, pricing, products and promotional activities.
* Identify market trends and new business opportunities.
* Analyse product performance and sales reports.

3. Sales & Marketing Support

* Develop marketing strategies and promotional plans for pharmaceutical products.
* Prepare visual aids, product presentations, product literature and promotional materials.
* Coordinate with RSMs, DSMs and the sales team to improve product performance.
* Provide product knowledge and scientific training to the sales team.
* Develop strategies for doctor engagement and prescription generation.

4. New Product Development

* Identify potential molecules and therapeutic segments for new product launches.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams for product development and launch planning.
* Study product positioning, pricing and market potential.

5. Coordination & Reporting

* Work closely with the sales, marketing and management teams.
* Track monthly product-wise sales and brand performance.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly product performance reports.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve sales and brand visibility.

Required Qualifications

* B.Pharm / M.Pharm / B.Sc. / M.Sc. (Life Sciences).
* MBA in Marketing will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and product management.

Experience

* 3–6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in pharmaceutical product management or brand management preferred.
* Experience in handling product portfolios, marketing strategies and sales team coordination.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Market research and analytical skills.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical products and therapeutic segments.
* Strategic thinking and planning.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Product-wise sales growth.
* New product launch performance.
* Market share and brand growth.
* Promotional strategy effectiveness.
* Sales team product knowledge and training.
* Achievement of product-wise business targets.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager - Data & AI
job_description:
**Job Title: Project / Product Manager**

**Location:** Gandhinagar (GNR) – Work From Office (WFO)

**Shift / Working Hours:** General Shift

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Company Overview**

Sarder Inc. is a global family of innovative companies united by a bold vision — to educate and certify over one billion people worldwide. We are redefining lifelong learning through a diverse portfolio that spans corporate training, AI certifications, eLearning, proctoring solutions, and thought-leadership media.

Our ecosystem includes NetCom Learning, NetCom+, AI Certs, AI Labs 365, Adoptify AI, and Sarder TV, each contributing to our mission of shaping a future-ready workforce in an AI-driven world.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an organized Project / Product Manager to coordinate projects across internal teams and external partners. The role involves gathering requirements, preparing PRDs and user stories, managing project timelines, and ensuring smooth communication between stakeholders. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to track progress, manage integrations, and ensure timely project delivery.

**What You Will Do**

Gather and document requirements from internal and external stakeholders.

Prepare PRDs and user stories for engineering teams.

Manage backlog grooming and support sprint planning using Agile/Scrum.

Coordinate partner and API integrations with technical teams.

Track project progress, follow up on deliverables, and identify risks or blockers.

Plan and coordinate UAT with internal teams and external stakeholders.

Maintain documentation of requirements, decisions, and workflows.

Manage daily communication with internal teams, partners, and vendors.

Review analytics using Mixpanel or Google Analytics to support prioritization.

Review wireframes and design flows in Figma to ensure alignment with requirements.

Manage project tracking and reporting using Jira, Confluence, ClickUp, or Asana.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Functional Skills (Must Have)**

Good understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

Experience in writing PRDs and user stories.

Knowledge of backlog grooming and sprint planning.

Experience in stakeholder and vendor management.

Strong requirement gathering and UAT coordination skills.

Good documentation and business analysis skills.

Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, ClickUp, or Asana.

Good knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.

Strong communication and coordination skills.

**Good to Have**

Basic understanding of REST APIs, Webhooks, and Postman.

Familiarity with Mixpanel and Google Analytics.

Basic knowledge of Figma, wireframes, and design flows.

**Candidate Profile**

A highly organized professional with strong communication, coordination, and documentation skills. Should be comfortable handling multiple stakeholders, gathering requirements, tracking project progress, and ensuring smooth execution without constant follow-ups or escalations.

**Education & Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcome.

2–4 years of relevant experience in Project Management, Product Management, or Business Analysis.

**Company Description**

**About the Company -**

(https://www.mastersindia.co/)

Masters India IT Solutions is a growing **B2B SaaS Product Company**, serving over 1500+ large enterprises. We are proud to be **Great Place To Work – Certified™**, reflecting our commitment to building a positive, growth-oriented workplace culture.

Masters India is one of the biggest GST Suvidha Providers (GSP) appointed by the Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) of the Government of India since 2017. Our mission is to build intuitive software solutions that simplify complex challenges faced by businesses across industries. We are fulfilling this mission by offering tax and financial automation products to enterprises.

Masters India IT Solutions is part of the 45-year-old Masters India Group, which has a diversified presence across Manufacturing, Healthcare, Hospitality, and IT, with an aggregate turnover of INR 1000+ Crores.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (CA) with hands-on experience in Product Management to build the strategy, roadmap, discovery and execution of our GST and e-invoicing platform.**

**This role sits at the intersection of tax regulations, finance operations and technology. You will be responsible for translating evolving statutory requirements and real-world taxpayer challenges into scalable, intuitive and technology-led SaaS products.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory & Product Planning**

* **Bring GST and Compliance expertise to product development, so that features are accurate, follow the law and are ready for regulatory changes on time.**

**Track GST Council decisions, CBIC/GSTN notifications and IRP/NIC changes, and turn them into product initiatives delivered ahead of compliance deadlines.**

* **Help prioritise initiatives based on customer impact, business value, regulatory urgency and technical feasibility.**
* **Spot market gaps and customer needs across enterprises, ERP ecosystems, GSPs/ASPs, tax practitioners and CA firms.**

**Domain Ownership**

* **Own the functional understanding of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2A/2B, GSTR-9/9C, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills.**
* **Translate law, rules and notifications into clear requirements, business rules, validations and user workflows.**
* **Define reconciliation logic and exception handling that improve accuracy, cut manual effort and reduce compliance risk.**

**Discovery & Execution**

* **Talk to customers, finance teams and CAs to understand workflows and pain points; validate ideas through prototypes and feedback.**
* **Identify AI and automation opportunities such as invoice data extraction, anomaly detection and reconciliation assistance.**
* **Write PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios; work with engineering on APIs, ERP integrations and system workflows.**
* **Lead UAT and functional validation to ensure regulatory accuracy and quality before release.**

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Must-Have**

* **Educational Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) with a demonstrated transition into Product Management.**
* **Domain Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Indian indirect tax, particularly GST law and processes, GST returns, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Exposure to GSP/ASP ecosystems, GSTN, IRP and NIC APIs**
* **Product experience: Hands-on experience across the product lifecycle (discovery, requirements, launch, iteration), ideally in compliance, tax-tech or fintech SaaS.**
* **Documentation: Clear PRDs, user stories, functional specs and test scenarios.**
* **Technical understanding: Working knowledge of APIs, integrations and ERP/accounting platforms; comfortable working with engineers.**
* **Data & communication: Uses data and customer insights to make decisions; communicates well across engineering, business, customer success and leadership.**
* **Prior experience in tax advisory, statutory audit, finance operations or enterprise compliance before transitioning into Product Management**

**Good to Have**

* **Experience building AI-enabled products or features, with an understanding of AI capabilities and their application in compliance and finance workflows.**
* **Experience working with enterprise customers and ERP ecosystems such as SAP, Oracle and Tally.**
* **Understanding of data security, privacy, regulatory compliance and enterprise SaaS requirements.**

 **Qualifications**

**Chartered Accountant (CA) with a passion for Product Management**

 **Additional Information**

**Job Location:** Procapitus Business Park, D Block, Sector 63, Noida  
**Type:** Permanent, Onsite (5 Days)

**Notice Period:** Immediate -30 days  
  
**Industry:** IT Product

Business Unit (PA): Government & Institutional Business

Location: Mumbai

Job Function: Product

Role Type: Individual Contributor

Direct Reports: Nil

Travel: Low

Band: E4/D1

Version: 1.0

  

**Job Purpose**

Own end-to-end CGAS product management across Account A (Savings) and Account B (Term Deposit).

Ensure compliance with Income Tax provisions and CGAS rules while driving operational governance, portfolio growth and customer experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Development & Maintenance

Maintain CGAS product constructs, eligibility, validations and restrictions.

Drive product/system changes with Technology and Operations.

Update product/process documentation for regulatory changes.

Portfolio Management

Analyse market potential, competition and target segments.

Drive deposit growth through focused initiatives and customer education.

Monitor inflows, withdrawals, redeposits, utilization timelines and closures.

Publish portfolio MIS and leadership insights.

Stakeholder & Customer Engagement

Train branches/teams on CGAS and improve sourcing effectiveness.

Develop customer communication and product collateral.

Conduct customer engagement, events/webinars and track marketing effectiveness.

Customer Service

Manage CGAS escalations and supervisory complaints.

Guide branches on eligibility, documentation and processing.

Capture feedback and drive product/process improvements.

Compliance & Regulatory

Ensure adherence to CGAS rules, reinvestment conditions, timelines and documentation.

Govern withdrawals, redeposits, utilization controls and deceased claims.

Coordinate with Operations/Compliance and liaise with MoF/CBDT for guidelines and approvals.

Implement regulatory changes across channels.

Portal & Data Management

Maintain AskNow/internal communication channels.

Coordinate with BIU for accurate MIS and portal updates.

**Educational Qualifications**

Graduate/Post-Graduate in Business, Finance, Economics or related field; MBA mentioned in the JD.

**Key Skills**

CGAS and capital-gains exemption knowledge

Banking operations, KYC and documentation

CRMNext/Flexcube familiarity

Analytical and problem-solving skills

Stakeholder management and customer orientation

**Experience Required**

3–5 years in Product Management, Government Business or Liability Products.

**Major Stakeholders**

Operations, Branch Banking, BSG, Audit, Compliance/RRD, Legal, Digital/BSG and Marketing.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At VIL, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best.

  

VIL's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our Values of Passion, Boldness, Trust, Speed and Digital. role_title: Global Product Manager – Sustainable Seafood Certification (MSC/ASC)
title: Global Product Manager – Sustainable Seafood Certification (MSC/ASC)
job_description:
**Company Description**

We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

At SGS, we have an open corporate and international culture. We offer a dynamic work environment in a leading global company. Our high professional standards and our sustainability approach guarantee you a future-oriented work environment. We invest in our employees for the long term and are committed to supporting your development within the company. Our business principles include: Integrity, Health, Safety & Environment, Quality & Professionalism, Respect, Sustainability, and Leadership.

 **Job Description**

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Global Product Manager, MSC/ASC ensures that the certification services related to the MSC/ASC Chain of Custody and ASC Farm are successful and have long-term viability. The main responsibilities and purpose of this role are :

* To have overall responsibility for the successful management of the schemes ensuring the global operation is efficient and meets the expectations of SGS markets (affiliates), external clients, scheme owners and accreditation bodies.
* To ensure global internal and external KPIs are met, and all relevant approvals and accreditations are maintained to safeguard the SGS business and reputation.
* To provide overall commercial strategy and go-to-market (GTM) guidance for affiliates to facilitate product growth in key countries and regions.
* Digital mindset to track competitors' products, research and monitor market trends and to help improve the efficiency of the global MSC/ASC growth strategy.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITES**

**Operational:**

* To manage the Global MSC/ASC team in multiple locations effectively to ensure the team remains competent, motivated and efficient.
* Maintain full knowledge and understanding of SGS IT systems, procedures and external approval criteria to conduct audit report reviews and allow efficient management of technical review and certification decision process.
* Develop relevant internal and external KPIs and monitor them to facilitate decision-making and drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure all relevant accreditations and approvals are adhered to, to safeguard the SGS business and brand reputation.
* Manage the launch of new MSC/ASC schemes and revisions.
* Manage the costs and expenses of department effectively to contribute to the overall achievement of the department’s P&L targets.
* Carry out performance review appraisals for team and lead recruitment activity as necessary.

**Technical:**

* Act as the MSC/ASC technical expert for the global network and effectively convey key messages to stakeholders at all levels within the network demonstrating pragmatism whilst maintaining the integrity of the scheme.
* To achieve and maintain all required accreditations for MSC/ASC and maintain an accurate and up to date knowledge of the product regulatory evolution.
* Develop and maintain trusted relationships with the MSC/ASC Scheme technical management
* Communicate and interact effectively with other Product Managers for globally managed food schemes to evaluate opportunities for development and synergies.
* Actively participate in relevant scheme owner committees or working groups to ensure SGS maintains influence and exposure in the area.

**Commercial:**

* Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior leadership of MSC/ASC.
* Provide subject matter expertise to the Global Food Team, International Sales and Global Key Account Managers as needed.
* In line with the segment strategy, provide business plan for the growth of the product in key countries and regions.
* Alignment with Marketing function in the development of the relevant specific marketing materials to support business growth.
* Contribute to the achievement of the overall objectives of the Food Assurance business.

**General:**

* At all times, behave in accordance with the Company’s Code of Integrity & Professional Conduct.
* At all times, adopt a safe behavior by exercising due regard for the health and safety of employees and clients, in line with policies and procedures.
* This job description should not be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements, but a general description of the job.

**The role reports to the Global Food Certification Manager**

 **Qualifications**

**PROFILE**

* Extensive knowledge and experience of the MSC/ASC Seafood Certification certification business and relevant regulations.
* Ability to combine technical credibility with relationship management and commercial awareness.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Excellent understanding of food Aquaculture and quality systems in a certification and auditing context.
* Background from Certified Body is a must have.
* Digital mindset with experience of compliance, food safety and regulatory intelligence platforms.
* Pragmatic, with proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong team leadership and people management skills.
* Business / commercial acumen to support go-to-market (GTM) strategies.
* Pragmatic with ability to think outside the box.
* Excellent verbal, presentation and technical writing skills.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to build trusted relationships at all levels within and outside the organization.
* Attention to detail with ability to multi-task effectively, work under pressure.
* Ability to manage conflicting priorities across multiple countries or projects.
* Fluent in the English language.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
* Experience with Copilot 365 and/or similar AI‑powered productivity and decision‑support tools.

**DESIRABLE SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Lead auditor level (including the required food processing industry experience) qualification in specific product.
* People management and managing or working with remote teams.
* Extensive audit experience includes commercial proposal preparation (including extensive experience in multi-site proposals and Integrated Audit proposals).
* Responsibility for maintaining accreditation against ISO 17065.
* Work experience within a large multinational company and managing communication within a large network.

**Please note that this is a fully remote role, and we welcome candidates based across Europe or India who have a valid right to work in their country of residence. Please apply with your CV in English.**

 **Additional Information**

**Why SGS?**

* Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
* Flexible schedule and hybrid/remote model.
* SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
* Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
* Benefits platform.

**Join Us:** At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

We are partnering with you to find your next team member. To maximize the value of our upcoming intake session, we will use our AI tools to draft a clear, Sabre-branded job description before we meet. To do this, we need your **input below** —please complete the required fields with the **most relevant and accurate details** , and we will follow up with a full JD tailored to your needs.
  
**Preparing the Job Description**  
By defining the **core requirements** and **key advantages** of the role early, our talent acquisition team will translate your inputs into a polished draft to attract top talent.
  
**Please update the designated sections directly in the fields below before submitting your requisition.**-
  
**1. Role Overview**  
Provide a concise summary of three to four sentences detailing the core mission of the team and how this position aligns with our business strategy.

**As part of the Sabre Payments team, this Senior Product Manager will lead the definition, execution, and delivery of strategic payment initiatives critical to scaling Sabre’s global business. Operating at the core intersection of travel and modern financial technology, the role bridges commercial strategy and technical engineering to build robust, scalable payment capabilities. The successful candidate will resolve complex product challenges creatively to deliver high-impact solutions for our project teams, broader department, and travel partners. In doing so, this position directly advances Sabre’s overarching strategic vision of powering next-generation travel retailing and seamless transaction workflows worldwide.**

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Chennai, TN

**About The Role:**

Condé Nast is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Trusted Data Products to help transform how data powers insights, innovation, and decision-making across our global portfolio of brands. As AI reshapes how businesses interact with data, we are evolving our data platform to make trusted information more accessible, actionable, and intelligent. This role will help build the foundations that allow teams to move beyond traditional reporting toward AI-powered analytics, conversational insights, and better business decisions.

You will own the evolution of key capabilities within our enterprise data platform, including curated data products, and AI-enabled analytics experiences such as conversational data exploration. Working with Data Engineering, Analytics, and business teams around the world, you will turn complex data into reliable, accessible products that help people answer questions, uncover opportunities, and act on insights.

This is a highly collaborative, technically focused product role that combines hands-on execution with forward-looking thinking. You will help shape how data is structured, connected, and delivered for both human and AI consumption, while keeping the platform reliable, scalable, and responsive to changing needs. Your work will directly influence how Condé Nast uses data and AI to understand audiences, evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and make more informed decisions.

  

**What You'll Do**

Enable BI and analytics platform evolution.

* Drive technical enhancements that support BI, insights enablement, and AI-powered data experiences, working with global stakeholders to align platform improvements with business needs.
* Partner with Analytics and business teams globally to identify recurring challenges and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that improve data accessibility, self-service, and decision-making.
Manage engineering delivery, dependencies, release readiness, technical risks, and ongoing platform health; track measurable outcomes and communicate progress clearly.  

  

**Build trusted, AI-ready data products**

* Drive development of curated, business-ready Gold-layer data products that help teams move from fragmented reporting toward consistent, AI-powered insights and decision-making.
* Partner with Engineering, Analytics, and Data Governance on data contracts, definitions, quality standards, lineage, documentation, certification, and monitoring.
Identify opportunities to enhance and manage existing data products, such as Identity Resolution and Single Customer View, in partnership with their stakeholders and owners.  

  

**Develop Conversational Analytics and AI capabilities.**

* Drive development and continuous improvement of conversational AI capabilities, including the curated datasets needed to support trusted natural-language analytics.
* Work with Analytics and Engineering to improve semantic definitions, metadata, context, and data readiness so AI-generated answers are accurate and useful.
Establish evaluation, testing, feedback, and monitoring practices for conversational data access; identify opportunities to expand conversational analytics, AI assistants, and other capabilities that make insights more accessible and actionable.  

  

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including significant work on data platforms, analytics infrastructure, or technical data products.
* Hands-on familiarity with Databricks and modern lakehouse architecture or comparable platforms is highly desirable; experience with Databricks Genie or comparable conversational analytics capabilities is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, pipelines, medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), data quality, lineage, observability, and access controls.
* A track record of partnering closely with data engineers to deliver dependable platform capabilities, curated datasets, and technical improvements.
* Ability to turn broad goals into crisp requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and executable plans while exercising independent product judgment.
* Understanding of semantic and metrics layers, metadata, and the foundations needed for trustworthy AI-enabled analytics.
* Experience supporting BI and analytics tools and collaborating with analysts to solve recurring data-access and usability problems.
* Strong communication skills and experience working across global Engineering, Product, Analytics, and business teams.
* A systems mindset, curiosity about emerging AI capabilities, and a practical focus on platform reliability, adoption, and business value.
* Experience in media, publishing, advertising, subscriptions, or consumer data ecosystems is a plus.

**What happens next?**
======================

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

About Amgen

If you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever-better products that reach millions of patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.

**About the role**
==================

**Role description**
--------------------

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This role is the business product owner for technology, data and AI across Amgen’s Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process, from intake and requisition through purchase order (PO), receipt, invoice and payment. It translates the Global Procurement roadmap into a prioritized portfolio that improves automation, user experience and financial control.

Based in Hyderabad, this role connects intake and guided buying, SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, supplier onboarding and contract management. It leads business priorities, requirements and acceptance with P2P process owners, Finance/AP, Technology and delivery partners across the US, Europe and JAPAC.

Finance/AP and Treasury retain payment authorization and execution; Technology leads architecture, engineering and technical operations. The P2P Technology Lead aligns partners on outcomes, commitments and escalations.

**Roles and responsibilities**
------------------------------

### **P2P technology strategy and roadmap**

* Own the P2P product vision and technology roadmap within the Global Procurement technology and AI plan; prioritize investments against business value, risk, total cost of ownership and delivery dependencies.

* Lead delivery of P2P automation priorities such as touchless PO and invoice processing, AI-enabled AP recovery and overpayment detection, payment-term harmonization, card program enhancements and catalog expansion.

* Evaluate next-generation SAP Ariba and embedded AI capabilities against business needs, release availability, integration readiness and adoption costs; recommend where to use native capability or a partner solution.

* Define touchless processing by process stage, with agreed eligibility, exclusions and controls. For invoices, distinguish processing without manual intervention from invoice receipt to ready-to-pay status from payment authorization and execution.

### **Platform integration and ERP readiness**

* Lead business requirements for connected intake, procurement, supplier and contract workflows; ensure accurate transfer of approvals, purchasing data and transaction status across systems.

* Partner with the SAP S/4HANA program on open-PO transition, supplier master data, tax determination and e-invoicing; lead P2P business readiness for data reconciliation, end-to-end testing and cutover.

* Champion buying-channel compliance, including No PO–No Pay where applicable, guided routing, catalogs and approved exception handling in line with policy.

### **AI automation and data foundations**

* Shape and scale P2P automation and AI use cases, including requisition validation, invoice capture and matching, receipt workflows and duplicate-payment detection; define baselines, acceptance criteria and pilot-to-scale decisions.

* Partner with Technology and control owners to define AI access limits, evaluation criteria, human review and audit trails; monitor errors and false positives, with escalation and fallback procedures.

* Manage technology vendors and pilot partners through scoping, value validation and scale decisions; review business performance, service commitments and ongoing costs with the relevant owners.

* Define P2P data requirements for the enterprise data platform; work with data owners on quality, common identifiers, lineage and access so requisition, PO, receipt, invoice and payment records can be reconciled and analyzed.

### **Portfolio governance and delivery**

* Represent P2P in Source-to-Pay portfolio and program increment (PI) planning; maintain a prioritized backlog with clear business requirements, acceptance criteria, capacity, dependencies and committed or deferred scope.

* Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.
* ;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.

* Agree KPI baselines, definitions, targets and owners with P2P and Finance/AP. Track touchless invoice rate, e-invoice adoption, first-pass match rate, cycle time, cost per invoice and on-time payment, alongside adoption and service performance.

* Report realized benefits with Finance validation, separating cost savings, capacity released, working-capital impact and recovered cash; avoid double counting benefits across initiatives.

### **Platform operations and controls**

* Coordinate business response to critical P2P incidents with Technology and support partners; prioritize restoration, root-cause fixes and the elimination of recurring exceptions.

* Embed SOX requirements, segregation of duties, approval controls, audit evidence and data protection in requirements and testing; support control owners in resolving technology-related audit findings.

* Agree business release and service-readiness criteria, including regression testing, support handover and continuity arrangements for critical buying and invoicing workflows.

### **Stakeholder engagement and change**

* Partner closely with P2P global process owners, Finance/AP, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to convert pain points into prioritized, policy-aligned solutions.

* Lead and develop business analysts and digital product associates; set clear accountabilities, coach product and P2P skills, and coordinate managed-service and technology delivery resources.

* Strong functional experience with SAP Ariba and SAP ECC/S/4HANA procurement-to-finance integration, including approval workflows, invoice matching, supplier data and interface issue resolution.

* Proven record of leading procurement technology implementations, integrations and upgrades in a product or program ownership role.

* Experience delivering P2P automation or AI-enabled improvements with measurable outcomes, clear acceptance criteria and appropriate business controls.

* Ability to translate business needs into functional requirements, test scenarios and acceptance decisions, partnering effectively with architects, engineers and Finance control owners.

* At least 12 years of relevant business experience, including at least 6 years in procurement or P2P technology.

job_description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**

The Omni IVR Product Owner will be responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering enhancements that improve the customer voice experience through natural language understanding, intelligent call routing, and contact center automation. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, operations, and vendor partners to translate customer and advisor needs into actionable product requirements, optimize call flows, reduce misroutes, improve containment, and ensure IVR capabilities align with service strategy, operational readiness, and measurable business outcomes.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Partner closely with the Product Manager to translate the Omni IVR roadmap into prioritized features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint-ready backlog items that support natural language, call routing, and service experience objectives.
* Own day-to-day Product Owner responsibilities, including backlog refinement, story prioritization, dependency management, sprint planning support, requirement clarification, and coordination with delivery teams to ensure roadmap commitments are executed successfully.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, operations, technology, UX, analytics, and vendor partners to gather requirements, validate call flow changes, support testing, resolve defects, and drive continuous improvement across IVR routing, containment, and caller experience.

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 7–8 years of experience working with voice systems, IVR platforms, contact center technologies, or related customer service technology solutions.
* Experience serving as a Product Owner or in a similar product delivery role, including backlog management, user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, and sprint execution support.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, demos, testing support, and production readiness activities.
* Ability to translate business needs, caller experience goals, and operational requirements into clear features, user stories, call flow changes, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across Product Management, technology, operations, analytics, and vendor teams.

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* Advanced collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product Management, technology, operations, analytics, UX, vendors, and business stakeholders to drive shared outcomes.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, including the ability to lead requirement discussions, clarify complex needs, manage competing priorities, and build alignment across diverse teams.
* Value-driven product ownership mindset, with the ability to balance client experience, operational efficiency, technical feasibility, roadmap priorities, and delivery commitments while acting with integrity and helping the team win together.

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Experience with natural language understanding, conversational IVR, speech recognition, text-to-speech, intent design, call routing logic, or voice bot capabilities.
* Familiarity with contact center platforms, telephony technologies, CRM integrations, routing strategies, call flow design, or service center operations.
* Experience using data, reporting, or performance metrics such as containment, misroutes, transfer rates, call volume, average handle time, and customer experience trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Proficiency with Agile delivery tools and documentation practices, such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio, or similar tools used for backlog management, process flows, and requirement traceability.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals.   + OR equivalent experience.

* Track record of successful design, delivery, and iteration on complex projects with a diverse set of stakeholders.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
