title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a **technically strong Senior Product Manager with hands-on experience building and launching AI-powered B2B enterprise products**.

You will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for intelligent products and platform capabilities that solve complex customer and operational problems. Working closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Design, and Data teams, you will take capabilities from discovery and prototyping through production deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.

This role requires strong technical judgment, an understanding of enterprise workflows, and demonstrated AI product development experience—not just familiarity with AI tools.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning enterprise customer needs with business priorities.
* Lead customer discovery to identify high-value problems and determine where AI, deterministic workflows, or a combination of both provides the best solution.
* Translate complex requirements into clear PRDs, user journeys, feature specifications, user stories, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, technical feasibility, dependencies, risk, and delivery effort.
* Own the product lifecycle from concept and validation through launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.

### **AI Product Development**

* Lead the development of AI-powered experiences, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows.
* Partner with AI/ML and Engineering teams on model selection, grounding, tool integrations, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Define agent behaviors, intent routing, skill specifications, policy configurations, permissions, and fallback mechanisms.
* Establish evaluation frameworks and curated golden datasets to assess accuracy, task completion, reliability, safety, and edge-case handling.
* Define release criteria and production monitoring, balancing output quality, latency, inference cost, and user experience.
* Use customer feedback, evaluation results, and production insights to continuously improve AI capabilities.

### **Technical Product Leadership**

* Collaborate with Engineering on scalable services, Java-based microservices, Kafka event pipelines, and agentic platform integrations.
* Review system designs, API specifications, data models, and integration flows to clarify requirements and evaluate trade-offs.
* Define API requirements, data contracts, authentication and authorization needs, and failure-handling expectations.
* Partner with platform and data teams on schemas, instrumentation, observability, and integration dependencies.
* Ensure enterprise requirements—including security, privacy, access controls, reliability, scalability, and auditability—are incorporated into product decisions.
* Participate in technical troubleshooting and root-cause discussions with engineering teams.

### **Delivery, Measurement & Adoption**

* Own backlog prioritization and partner with engineering Scrum teams to deliver outcome-focused releases.
* Define and track KPIs across adoption, task success, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, AI quality, and cost.
* Validate solutions through prototypes, experiments, pilot programs, and customer feedback.
* Drive launch readiness, stakeholder communication, user enablement, and change management.
* Communicate roadmap decisions, dependencies, risks, and technical trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* **5+ years of Product Management experience**, with ownership of technically complex products.
* **B2B enterprise product management experience is a must**, including experience addressing complex workflows, integrations, and the needs of multiple stakeholders.
* **Proven experience building and shipping AI/ML-powered products into production**, with direct ownership of discovery, requirements, evaluation, launch, and measurable outcomes.
* Strong practical understanding of LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, tool calling, and AI limitations and failure modes.
* Experience defining AI evaluation criteria, test scenarios, quality benchmarks, and production feedback loops.
* Strong technical fluency across distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, APIs, and data platforms.
* Hands-on experience working with RESTful APIs, webhooks, authentication mechanisms, and enterprise integrations.
* Ability to read and discuss architecture diagrams, API documentation, data models, and technical specifications with engineering teams.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with experience defining KPIs and using data to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* **Experience building campaign management or CRM products.**
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent orchestration, and reusable AI tools or skills.
* Experience authoring PRD-as-Code artifacts, including intent definitions, skill specifications, and policy configurations.
* Familiarity with Java-based services, Kafka, cloud infrastructure, and AI observability tools.
* Experience with AI security, privacy, prompt-injection risks, and responsible AI practices.
* Ability to use SQL, API testing tools, and workflow automation tools to validate assumptions and investigate issues.
* Prior experience in automotive retail, dealer technology, or enterprise operational workflows.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Technical Product Manager (TPM) for CareSelect Imaging is responsible for translating product strategy, customer needs, and business priorities into clear, executable technical work and driving that work through successful delivery.

This role serves as a critical connection point between Product Management and Engineering, partnering closely with development teams in India and the U.S., as well as Architecture, QA, Operations, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders. The Senior TPM must be able to understand the intended business and customer outcome, translate that need into manageable technical capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and remain actively engaged through planning, development, testing, release, and post-release validation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with disciplined product execution. This individual does not need to be the solution architect or engineering lead, but must be technically fluent enough to understand system interactions, integrations, APIs, data flows, dependencies, and technical constraints; ask the right questions; challenge assumptions; and facilitate alignment between business and technical teams.

A key measure of success in this role is the ability to turn complex or sometimes ambiguous business needs into well-understood, appropriately scoped work that engineering teams can execute predictably.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Translate strategy into executable work: Partner with Product Management to translate business, customer, and product needs into well-defined capabilities, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized technical work
* Own backlog readiness and work decomposition: Break complex initiatives into manageable increments, maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog, and ensure work is sufficiently defined and understood before entering development
* Partner closely with Engineering: Work day-to-day with onshore and offshore Engineering, Architecture, and QA teams to clarify requirements, evaluate technical approaches, understand APIs, integrations, data flows, and dependencies, and resolve questions throughout development
* Drive delivery across teams: Support sprint and PI planning, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and proactively manage scope, risks, blockers, and decisions from initial definition through development and delivery
* Ensure quality and release readiness: Partner with Engineering and QA on testing, acceptance criteria, UAT, release readiness, and deployment activities, ensuring product changes meet intended business and customer outcomes
* Communicate and continuously improve: Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and release impacts while identifying opportunities to improve requirements quality, delivery predictability, and collaboration across distributed teams
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
* 3+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, product management, business systems analysis, or technology delivery
* Experience working directly with engineering leadership, architects, and distributed development teams
* Experience supporting PI planning, dependency management, and scaled Agile delivery
* Experience managing and prioritizing backlogs in an Agile product-development environment
* Experience partnering directly with engineering teams to clarify requirements and drive work through planning and delivery
* Experience with Agile and portfolio-management tools such as Aha, Rally, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
* Demonstrated experience decomposing complex capabilities or features into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and drive alignment across multiple engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to understand and communicate end-to-end technical concepts, including data flows, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, or enterprise systems
* Demonstrated solid facilitation, written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, cross-team dependencies, and delivery risks

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare technology, healthcare payer operations, claims, prior authorization, clinical data, or managed-service platforms
* Experience operating within a scaled Agile or PI-planning environment
* Knowledge of cloud technologies, DevOps practices, integration testing, and automation
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHI

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Leader / Product Manager -SDS2
job_description:
**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

What we are looking for

We are hiring a **Product Manager for SDS2** who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical understanding of **structural steel fabrication, detailing, or manufacturing**. This is not intended to be a general-purpose software PM role.

The ideal candidate understands how engineering software fits into real fabrication workflows and has an **AI-first mindset**, actively looking for ways AI can improve detailing, automation, decision-making, user productivity, and the way we build products.

Industry & Technical Background

* Strong experience with **structural steel fabrication, steel detailing, manufacturing, or closely related industrial engineering workflows**
* Ability to communicate credibly with detailers, fabricators, engineers, developers, and customers
* Bachelor's degree in **engineering, architecture, or a closely related technical field**
* Understanding of complex engineering/manufacturing workflows and the ability to translate them into software requirements

Product Management

* Ideally **5+ years of Product Management / Product Ownership experience**, preferably with AEC, engineering, manufacturing, or technical B2B software
* Demonstrated ownership of:
  + Product vision and roadmap
  + Customer discovery and requirements
  + Epics and backlog prioritization
  + Agile product development
  + Product lifecycle
  + Market and competitive analysis
  + Product launches / GTM
  + Product metrics and business outcomes
* Strong project-management capability across distributed, cross-functional teams
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer-facing communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with Engineering, UX, Sales, Support, Marketing, customers, and senior leadership.
* **Jira** for requirements, epics, backlog, and Agile development
* **Basecamp** for project/program coordination
* Customer-facing product discovery
* Structural engineering knowledge
* Fabrication shop experience
* BIM / digital fabrication workflows
* APIs, interoperability, or integrations
* Enterprise B2B software experience
* Data-driven product management

AI-First Mindset

We want someone who views **AI as a fundamental part of the future of SDS2**, not simply another feature.

Look for candidates who:

* Routinely use AI tools in their own work
* Understand practical applications of **AI/ML, copilots, agents, automation, or intelligent workflows**
* Can identify repetitive or knowledge-intensive detailing tasks that could be automated or augmented
* Can translate AI opportunities into customer problems, workflows, requirements, and measurable outcomes
* Are curious and willing to experiment rather than waiting for established industry solutions

Direct AI product experience is highly desirable but should **not outweigh steel-industry/domain knowledge**.

Strong Differentiators

Experience with one or more of the following should move a candidate **significantly higher in the recruiting funnel**:

**Steel / Detailing Software**

* SDS2
* Tekla Structures
* Advance Steel
* Bocad
* ProSteel
* Other structural steel detailing / fabrication systems

**Engineering / Manufacturing Software**

* SolidWorks
* Autodesk Inventor
* Creo
* CATIA
* Bentley engineering products
* Other CAD/CAM/CAE, BIM, PLM, or fabrication software

  
**Additional Information**

#NemetschekIndia #LI-Hybrid #LI-NB1

title: Digital Product Manager - API Management Platforms (Apigee & IBM DataPower)
job_description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

Role Overview  
  
We are seeking an experienced Digital Product Manager to drive the strategy, roadmap, adoption, and lifecycle management of our enterprise API Management platforms, including Apigee and IBM DataPower. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of product management, API ecosystem, integration architecture, platform governance, and stakeholder management experience.  
  
This role will be responsible for defining the product vision, prioritizing platform capabilities, driving modernization initiatives, enabling development teams, and ensuring the platform delivers secure, scalable, and reliable API services across the enterprise.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Define and own the product strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for API Management platforms including Apigee and IBM DataPower.
* Partner with business, architecture, security, operations, and engineering teams to identify platform needs and translate them into prioritized product features and capabilities.
* Drive API platform adoption across enterprise teams by promoting best practices, standards, and self-service capabilities.
* Manage product backlogs, feature prioritization, release planning, and stakeholder communications.
* Establish API governance, security, lifecycle management, and onboarding standards.
* Lead modernization initiatives involving API gateways, cloud-native architectures, AI-driven integrations, and developer experience enhancements.
* Work closely with engineering teams to define platform requirements related to scalability, resiliency, performance, observability, and operational excellence.
* Define and track platform KPIs, adoption metrics, API consumption trends, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Collaborate with vendor partners and internal leadership to evaluate emerging technologies and platform enhancements.
* Drive continuous improvement through feedback loops, platform analytics, and operational insights.
* Support budgeting, capacity planning, and investment decisions related to API management platforms.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 12+ years of experience in Product Management, API Management, Integration Platforms, or Enterprise Middleware technologies.
* Strong experience with **Apigee API Management** and **IBM DataPower Gateway** platforms.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise platform products and driving platform adoption at scale.
* Deep understanding of API design, REST services, API lifecycle management, developer portals, and API governance.
* Experience working in Agile product management environments with responsibility for roadmap planning and backlog prioritization.
* Strong understanding of API security concepts including OAuth, JWT, mTLS, OpenID Connect, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or similar tools.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.
* Experience partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with AI Gateway capabilities and GenAI platform integrations.
* Exposure to Kong, MuleSoft, Azure API Management, or other API gateway technologies.
* Experience with Kubernetes, container platforms, and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Relevant certifications in Product Management, Cloud, Apigee, or Agile methodologies.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**
----------------------------

* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence decisions across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strategic thinker with a customer-first mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale platform transformation initiatives.
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Increased API platform adoption and developer satisfaction.
* Improved platform reliability, scalability, and security posture.
* Delivery of roadmap commitments aligned to business priorities.
* Reduction in API onboarding time and operational overhead.
* Enhanced observability, governance, and compliance across the API ecosystem.

**Primary Skills**

Business Case Analyses, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Systems Thinking

**Shift Time**

**Recruiter Info**

Yateesh B Gybgaa@allstate.com

**About Allstate**

**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

Learn more about Allstate India here.

**Team Overview**

The Technical Platform Manager (TPM) is responsible for driving the strategy, roadmap, adoption, governance, and delivery of enterprise platform services that enable secure, scalable, and efficient software development and infrastructure operations across the organization.
  
  
This role partners with platform service owners, engineering leaders, architecture, security, compliance, cloud engineering, and application development teams to define platform capabilities, establish operational excellence standards, drive platform adoption, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The TPM serves as a strategic leader who balances platform scalability, reliability, security, developer experience, and cost optimization while ensuring enterprise platform services continue to meet evolving business and technology needs.
  
  
Platform domains may include Data Ingestion, Data Quality, ETL, Web Applications, Observability, Infrastructure Automation, PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management , Developer Tooling, and Internal Developer Platforms.
  
  
This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

**Data Platform Strategy & Roadmap Management**

* Define and manage the product roadmap for enterprise data acquisition, ingestion, correction, storage, and distribution platforms, including: Data Acquisition & Onboarding ServicesData Ingestion Pipelines (Batch and Real-Time)Data Quality & Validation ServicesData Correction Platforms (Consumer, Commercial, Fraud, MFI)Enterprise Data Store (EDS)Data Publishing & Distribution ServicesCDC, Streaming, and Event-Driven ArchitectureRedis and Low-Latency Data Access PlatformsData APIs and Data-as-a-Service Capabilities
* Establish product vision and strategy for enterprise data platforms aligned with business growth, regulatory requirements, and customer needs.
* Drive prioritisation of platform investments that improve data quality, scalability, timeliness, availability, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Product, Analytics, and Operations teams to define roadmap alignment, capability evolution, and technical strategy.
* Balance regulatory obligations, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, and business-driven feature delivery.

**Data Product Adoption & Customer Success**

* Drive adoption of enterprise data platform capabilities across internal and external consumers.
* Develop deep understanding of data providers, operational users, analytics teams, product teams, and application consumers.
* Establish feedback loops with stakeholders to continuously improve data acquisition, correction, fulfilment, and data access experiences.
* Measure and report product adoption, service utilisation, customer satisfaction, data quality improvements, and business value realization.
* Champion self-service capabilities that enable data onboarding, monitoring, corrections, and operational management with minimal engineering intervention.

**Data Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Define and maintain operational frameworks governing data ingestion, validation, correction, retention, distribution, and lifecycle management.
* Establish KPIs and success metrics across: Data AvailabilityPipeline ThroughputData FreshnessData AccuracyData CompletenessData Quality ScoresOperational SLA ComplianceCustomer AdoptionPlatform Reliability

job_description:
**Organization:**  
At CommBank, you will work in an environment that aims to combine the scale and responsibility of Australia's leading bank with empowered, product-led teams. Our best teams are outcome-focused and take end-to-end ownership. That means staying close to the customer problem, using evidence to make decisions, being clear about trade-offs, learning quickly and owning what we build through its full lifecycle. It also means delivering safely and sustainably: risk, resilience and controls are part of good product design, not something added at the end. We value people who demonstrate Care, Courage and Commitment. You will have the opportunity to work on a material payments problem, own an important product area within a new strategic capability, collaborate with deep payments and technology specialists, and explore how automation and emerging AI can responsibly transform payment servicing.

**Job Title:** Senior Product Lead

**Location:** Bangalore

**Business & Team:**

As Product Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will own a defined product area within the broader Payment Exceptions & Investigations product stream. Working within the product strategy and direction established for the stream, you will translate customer and operational problems into clear product outcomes, priorities and an executable roadmap for your squad. You will lead the product lifecycle for your area from discovery and problem definition through delivery, adoption, run performance and continuous optimisation. You will make evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology and delivery considerations, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Architecture, Payments Operations, frontline teams, Risk and other specialist teams.

You will work closely with other Product Leads and Product Managers across the PEX stream to ensure your product area contributes to coherent end-to-end payment exception journeys and reusable capabilities rather than creating isolated solutions.

**Impact & contribution:**

As a Product Lead within the Payments Channel and Reporting Crew, you will work closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes for our business stakeholders and customers. You will be responsible for developing and delivering customer reporting capability for the Payments Domain. This will incorporate the delivery of reports, modernisation of existing reporting capabilities and development of the strategic roadmap for future state delivery. You will be leading a team of engineering experts to achieve this, while creating a psychologically safe, inclusive, accountable and high-performance culture, and working collaboratively within and across Crews.

  

**Reporting lines:** Dhivya Elanchezhian – Senior Product Capability Lead

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the product vision, outcomes and roadmap for a defined Payment Exceptions & Investigations product area, aligned to the overall PEX product strategy.
* Deeply understand the customer, colleague and operational problems within your product area through discovery, data, research and engagement with frontline and operational teams.
* Translate those problems into clearly defined product opportunities, measurable outcomes and prioritised initiatives.
* Own squad-level prioritisation and roadmap decisions, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology, delivery constraints and expected business outcomes.
* Lead discovery and delivery of reusable product capabilities that contribute to the broader PEX target state rather than creating point solutions for individual processes or systems.
* Shape simple experiences for customers, bankers, investigators and payment operations colleagues within your product area.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on product and engineering trade-offs, feasibility, sequencing, integration and delivery confidence
* Identify opportunities to move journeys from manual handling toward assisted resolution and straight-through processing where policy, evidence and controls support it.
* Explore practical applications of automation and AI for use cases such as context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation support, next-best-action and response drafting.
Ensure AI-enabled and automated outcomes within your product area are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.Use customer, operational and product data to understand product performance, identify recurring pain points and continuously optimise outcomes.Define and own measurable product outcomes relevant to your area, which may include resolution time, straightthrough-processing rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness and colleague adoption.Embed risk, controls, regulatory and operational resilience considerations throughout discovery, design, delivery and ongoing product management.Lead and develop Product Managers within your squad/product area and contribute to strong product discipline across the broader PEX stream.Partner with other PEX Product Leads and Product Managers to manage dependencies and deliver consistent endto-end customer and colleague outcomes.  

**Essential Skills:**

We’re interested in hearing from people who:

* Bring strong product management and product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from discovery through delivery, adoption and continuous optimisation.
* Have payments domain knowledge, ideally across Australian domestic and/or international payments, payment processing, exceptions or servicing.
* Understand, or are able to develop strong knowledge of, payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and international/correspondent banking.
* Have experience with payment investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments, mistaken payments or related exception-servicing journeys.
* Have worked with complex workflow, case-management, servicing, operational or platform products, preferably within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Demonstrate strong product discovery, customer research, roadmap, prioritisation and lifecycle-management disciplines.
* Can turn complex customer and operational problems into simple product propositions and pragmatic delivery increments.
* Are comfortable making evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational outcomes, technology, risk and delivery considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and customer-facing teams.Understand risk, controls and operational resilience and embed them into product decisions rather than treating them as downstream gates.
* Are curious about automation, AI and emerging technologies and can identify where they create genuine customer or operational value.
Coach Product Managers, create clarity through ambiguity and build collaborative, outcome-focused teams  

**Years of Experience:** 11+
  
We are seeking an experienced Product Lead with business/product background and payments domain expertise.

  

**Qualifications:** B.Tech

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

Advertising End Date: 29/11/2026

title: Sr. Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As a Sr. Product Manager on the Strategic Partner Integration team, you will own a defined product area within Docusign’s strategic integrations. Your initial focus will be procurement integrations, connecting agreement workflows to source-to-pay and procure-to-pay processes across systems like SAP and other major platforms. You will collaborate closely across customers, partners, Product, Engineering, Sales, and the broader Docusign ecosystem. In this role, you will lead integrations end-to-end—from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. As the portfolio evolves, your scope may expand to additional strategic partner and enterprise-system integrations.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director, Product Management.

**Responsibility**

* Own the roadmap and priorities for designated strategic partner integrations, translating customer, partner, market, and technical insights into clear requirements and measurable outcomes
* Lead end-to-end product development, from discovery and requirements through design, development, launch, adoption, and post-launch iteration
* Conduct customer and partner discovery, synthesize feedback and technical requirements, and translate them into product narratives, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs
* Partner with strategic ISVs to align on integration use cases, product requirements, responsibilities, dependencies, delivery plans, and launch readiness
* Define seamless integration experiences across APIs, bidirectional data flows, embedded user experiences, data mapping and agentic workflows in partnership with Engineering and Design
* Lead one or more cross-functional product development teams, coordinating dependencies and keeping execution aligned to agreed scope, milestones, and quality expectations
* Contribute to the broader Docusign ecosystem strategy and roadmap by sharing customer insights, delivery learnings, and opportunities to improve repeatability across future integrations
* Collaborate with Business Development, Partner Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support on launch plans, field enablement, customer communications, and adoption programs
* Establish and monitor product success metrics such as integration activation, usage, workflow completion, partner and customer adoption, reliability, and time to value; use insights to prioritize improvements
* Communicate product direction, roadmap, progress, risks, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and external partners, escalating material issues when needed
* Share product management practices and provide informal mentorship to less-experienced colleagues, without formal people-management responsibility

  
  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* 10+ years of related product management experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 8+ years of related experience with a master’s degree; equivalent experience may be considered
* Experience leading product strategy and roadmap execution for a feature area, platform capability, or product in enterprise SaaS, enterprise applications, or integration-focused products
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development from discovery and requirements through launch, adoption, and iteration
* Experience working directly with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to understand problems, define requirements, make trade-offs, and deliver products that solve meaningful business needs
* Technical fluency and the ability to engage effectively with Engineering and Architecture on APIs, integration patterns, data models, authentication, event-driven workflows, and embedded experiences
* Hands-on experience with building AI agents, skills and/or MCP tools and integrating with leading AI platforms
Experience working in an Agile product development environment with globally distributed teams  

**Preferred**

* Experience building or managing integrations with procurement, ERP, CRM, CLM, or other systems of record; experience with platforms such as SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Oracle, or Salesforce a big plus.
* Domain knowledge in procurement, source-to-pay, procure-to-pay, supplier management, contract lifecycle management, or agreement workflows]
* Experience defining partner-facing products, integration applications, APIs, developer experiences, or embedded workflows
* Experience working with external technology partners to align priorities, coordinate delivery plans, and support joint launches
* Experience sharing product practices, mentoring peers, or serving as a product resource in a matrixed organization
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical and business concepts to partners, customers, cross-functional teams, and executives
* Strong analytical orientation, with experience using product and business data to make prioritization decisions and improve adoption
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

* Contribute to the broader Docusign ecosystem strategy and roadmap by sharing customer insights, delivery learnings, and opportunities to improve repeatability across future integrations
* Collaborate with Business Development, Partner Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support on launch plans, field enablement, customer communications, and adoption programs
* Establish and monitor product success metrics such as integration activation, usage, workflow completion, partner and customer adoption, reliability, and time to value; use insights to prioritize improvements
* Communicate product direction, roadmap, progress, risks, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and external partners, escalating material issues when needed
* Share product management practices and provide informal mentorship to less-experienced colleagues, without formal people-management responsibility

  
  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* 10+ years of related product management experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 8+ years of related experience with a master’s degree; equivalent experience may be considered
* Experience leading product strategy and roadmap execution for a feature area, platform capability, or product in enterprise SaaS, enterprise applications, or integration-focused products
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development from discovery and requirements through launch, adoption, and iteration
* Experience working directly with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to understand problems, define requirements, make trade-offs, and deliver products that solve meaningful business needs
* Technical fluency and the ability to engage effectively with Engineering and Architecture on APIs, integration patterns, data models, authentication, event-driven workflows, and embedded experiences
* Hands-on experience with building AI agents, skills and/or MCP tools and integrating with leading AI platforms
Experience working in an Agile product development environment with globally distributed teams  

**Preferred**

* Experience building or managing integrations with procurement, ERP, CRM, CLM, or other systems of record; experience with platforms such as SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Oracle, or Salesforce a big plus.
* Domain knowledge in procurement, source-to-pay, procure-to-pay, supplier management, contract lifecycle management, or agreement workflows]
* Experience defining partner-facing products, integration applications, APIs, developer experiences, or embedded workflows
* Experience working with external technology partners to align priorities, coordinate delivery plans, and support joint launches
* Experience sharing product practices, mentoring peers, or serving as a product resource in a matrixed organization
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical and business concepts to partners, customers, cross-functional teams, and executives
* Strong analytical orientation, with experience using product and business data to make prioritization decisions and improve adoption
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

job_description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

**About Amtech**

Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.

With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.

**Our Employee Value Proposition**

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:

**Purpose**

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

**Growth**

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

**Culture**

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

**Innovation**

Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Sr Product Owner, based in Amtech India, to support product execution for our labeling ERP product line and to coordinate and support the product owners working across our labeling and corrugated ERP product lines.

On the product side, this role performs the product-management execution work for the labeling line of business in close partnership with in-market product leadership. Working with product management and market-facing stakeholders, the Senior Product Owner translates roadmap initiatives and projects into actionable development work, produces and maintains product artifacts, and drives delivery — while market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set jointly with in-market leadership.

On the coordination side, this role supports and oversees the product-owner process for the India-based team: scheduling and facilitating agile ceremonies, acting as a quality gate on product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts, and building a strong product-owner community of practice. This is a coordination and enablement role; it does not carry direct people-management responsibility.

The ideal candidate understands manufacturing operations, ERP systems, and agile product development, and is comfortable working across technical teams, product owners, and in-market product leadership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Product Execution (Labeling Product Line)**

* Perform product-management execution for the labeling product line in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Translate roadmap initiatives and projects into epics, user stories, and a well-formed backlog.

* Produce and maintain product artifacts, working with in-market leadership to close market-facing gaps.

* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes in line with roadmap direction set with in-market leadership.

* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan sprints across multiple months.

**Product Owner Coordination & Enablement (Both Product Lines)**

* Coordinate and support the product owners working across the labeling and corrugated product lines in India.

* Schedule, facilitate, and oversee agile ceremonies — Program Increment (PI) Planning, Sprint Planning, and Sprint Reviews.

* Review and act as a quality gate on the completeness and quality of PDLC artifacts.

* Build and support a product-owner community of practice — shared standards, templates, and continuous improvement.

* Help product owners grow in their craft through coaching, feedback, and shared best practices.

**Agile Development Collaboration**

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during sprint planning, development, and release cycles.

* Coordinate with product managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment planning.

* Participate in sprint ceremonies including planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

* Clarify requirements and ensure development teams understand the desired product outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work with in-market product leadership (product management and market-facing stakeholders) to align execution with roadmap and customer needs.

* Work with implementation, support, and sales teams to ensure product features align with customer needs.

* Provide product expertise for internal stakeholders and help drive continuous improvement of product capabilities.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7+ years experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst in a software environment, including experience leading or coordinating other product owners.

* Strong experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments and facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning.

* Experience with ERP systems.

* Strong experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining and reviewing product requirements.

* Demonstrated ability to set and uphold quality standards for product artifacts.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with distributed and in-market teams.

* Product backlog and requirements management

* Agile / Scrum facilitation and PI planning

* Product-owner coordination and enablement

* PDLC artifact quality and standards

* Stakeholder communication across distributed teams

* ERP / manufacturing domain

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with manufacturing, ERP, or scheduling applications.

* Knowledge of production operations, shop floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.

* Experience working in a distributed / offshore model in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Experience establishing or supporting a product-owner community of practice.
* Experience with tools such as Jira or similar backlog management systems.

**Why Join Amtech**

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

**Jr. Product Manager**

**Company:** ModelsLab  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Location:** Gandhinagar, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** Full-time, Work From Office

About ModelsLab & MStudio.ai

ModelsLab is a technology company focused on building innovative AI and SaaS products.

Our flagship product, **MStudio.ai**, is an AI filmmaking platform that brings the entire creative filmmaking workflow into one place. From scriptwriting, character creation, image generation, video generation, and voice to timeline-based editing, MStudio.ai provides the tools needed to create films and visual content.

We are looking for a proactive Junior Product Manager to help us plan, manage, and improve our products.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand business requirements and convert them into product requirements.
* Manage product features, roadmaps, and development priorities.
* Coordinate with developers, designers, marketing, and other teams.
* Prepare product documentation, PRDs, feature specifications, and user stories.
* Track product development progress, deadlines, and milestones.
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Collect user feedback and identify opportunities for product improvement.
* Coordinate product testing, bug tracking, and feature releases.
* Understand user journeys and improve MStudio.ai workflows.
* Monitor product performance and suggest new features.

Required Skills

* 1–2 years of experience in Product Management or a similar role.
* Understanding of SaaS products and software development.
* Familiarity with Agile methodology and product development lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Jira, Trello, Notion, or similar tools.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with different teams.

**Additional Advantage:** Experience working with AI products, creative tools, video platforms, or SaaS applications.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who takes ownership, thinks from the user's perspective, understands business requirements, and can turn ideas into actionable product improvements.

**Apply:** hr@modelslab.com

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Each TPM is responsible for managing specific product modules or features, contributing to the broader product roadmap while aligning execution with organizational goals and customer needs.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

The Consultant (P03) – Technical Product Management (TPM) role is responsible for driving the end-to-end delivery of technology-enabled product features by effectively bridging business requirements with engineering execution. The role combines product ownership, technical understanding, and Agile delivery to ensure the development of scalable, high-quality solutions aligned with customer needs and organizational priorities.

At this level, the TPM owns feature-level execution, collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, and contributes to product strategy and roadmap under guidance from senior product leaders.
  
  
Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

**1. Product Ownership**

* Own and manage assigned product features or modules from concept to delivery
* Define detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and maintain the product backlog
* Prioritize deliverables based on business value, customer impact, and feasibility

**2. Product Strategy & Roadmap Support**

* Contribute to product roadmap planning and execution
* Align feature development with overall product vision and business objectives
* Incorporate stakeholder input, user feedback, and analytics insights

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications
* Work closely with engineering teams on solution design and implementation
* Assess technical trade-offs, dependencies, and constraints
* Ensure adherence to scalability, security, and performance standards

**4. Agile Delivery Execution**

* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, retrospectives)
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of product increments
* Support continuous improvement in development and delivery processes

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with business, engineering, and UX/design teams
* Act as the primary point of contact for owned features
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes effectively

**6. Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Define and track KPIs for product features
* Use product analytics and user insights to drive improvements
* Optimize product performance, usability, and adoption

**7. Product Lifecycle Support**

* Support the full product lifecycle including requirement gathering, development, testing, and release
* Assist in documentation, training, and user adoption initiatives

Ensure smooth rollout and continuous enhancement of features

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

The ideal candidate should have 5–8 years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Management, or software/program delivery roles, with a strong understanding of the product lifecycle and Agile methodologies. They should possess solid knowledge of SDLC, ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, and familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills are essential, along with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required, with Agile certifications (CSPO/CSM) considered an added advantage.

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.
